>>> app/Services/NotificationService.php
     1	<?php
     2	namespace App\Services;
     3	
     4	use App\Models\Notification;
     5	use App\Models\Echeance;
     6	use App\Models\Vente;
     7	use App\Models\Produit;
     8	use Illuminate\Support\Str;
     9	
    10	class NotificationService
    11	{
    12	    public static function generer(): array
    13	    {
    14	        $nb = 0;
    15	        $aujourdhui = now()->toDateString();
    16	
    17	        // 0. Pénalités en attente (calcul automatique)
    18	        PenaliteService::genererEnAttente();
    19	        PenaliteService::genererPenalitesRetardPaye();
    20	
    21	        // Supprimer les anciennes notifications d'échéances et de retards
    22	        Notification::whereIn('type', ['echeance', 'retard'])->delete();
    23	
    24	        // 1. Échéances du jour — notifier les agents
    25	        $echeancesJour = Echeance::whereDate('date_echeance', $aujourdhui)
    26	            ->where('statut', 'en_attente')
    27	            ->with('vente.agent', 'vente.debiteur')
    28	            ->get();
    29	
    30	        foreach ($echeancesJour as $e) {
    31	            $agentId = $e->vente->agent_id;
    32	            $debiteur = $e->vente->debiteur;
    33	            if (!$agentId || !$debiteur) continue;
    34	
    35	            Notification::create([
    36	                'uuid' => Str::uuid(),
    37	                'user_id' => $agentId,
    38	                'type' => 'echeance',
    39	                'titre' => 'Échéance du jour',
    40	                'message' => $debiteur->nom . ' doit payer ' . number_format($e->montant_prevu, 0, ',', ' ') . ' FCFA aujourd\'hui.',
    41	                'lien' => '#agent-space',
    42	            ]);
    43	            $nb++;
    44	        }
    45	
    46	        // 2. Retards — regrouper par débiteur et agent
    47	        $retardsGroupes = Echeance::whereIn('statut', ['en_retard', 'partiel'])
    48	            ->whereDate('date_echeance', '<', $aujourdhui)
    49	            ->with(['vente.debiteur', 'vente.agent'])
    50	            ->get()
    51	            ->groupBy(fn($e) => $e->vente->debiteur_id . '|' . $e->vente->agent_id);
    52	
    53	        foreach ($retardsGroupes as $key => $echeances) {
    54	            [$debiteurId, $agentId] = explode('|', $key);
    55	            $debiteur = $echeances->first()->vente->debiteur;
    56	            if (!$debiteur || !$agentId) continue;
    57	
    58	            $totalRestant = $echeances->sum(fn($e) => $e->restant());
    59	            $maxRetard = $echeances->max('jours_retard');
    60	            $nbEcheances = $echeances->count();
    61	
    62	            Notification::create([
    63	                'uuid' => Str::uuid(),
    64	                'user_id' => $agentId,
    65	                'type' => 'retard',
    66	                'titre' => 'Retard de paiement',
    67	                'message' => $debiteur->nom . ' a ' . $nbEcheances . ' échéance(s) en retard (retard max : ' . $maxRetard . ' jours). Restant : ' . number_format($totalRestant, 0, ',', ' ') . ' FCFA.',
    68	                'lien' => '#agent-space',
    69	            ]);
    70	            $nb++;
    71	        }
    72	
    73	        // 3. Stocks faibles — notifier la gérante
    74	        $stocksFaibles = Produit::where('actif', true)
    75	            ->where('stock', '<=', \DB::raw('seuil_alerte'))
    76	            ->where(function($q){ $q->where('stock', '>', 0)->orWhere('stock_initial', '>', 0); })
    77	            ->get();
    78	
    79	        $gerante = \App\Models\User::where('role', 'gerante')->first();
    80	        if ($gerante && $stocksFaibles->isNotEmpty()) {
    81	            // Supprimer les anciennes notifications de stock pour la gérante
    82	            Notification::where('user_id', $gerante->id)
    83	                ->where('type', 'stock')
    84	                ->delete();
    85	
    86	            foreach ($stocksFaibles as $p) {
    87	                Notification::create([
    88	                    'uuid' => Str::uuid(),
    89	                    'user_id' => $gerante->id,
    90	                    'type' => 'stock',
    91	                    'titre' => 'Stock faible',
    92	                    'message' => $p->nom . ' : ' . $p->stock . ' unité(s) (seuil : ' . $p->seuil_alerte . ')',
    93	                    'lien' => '#stocks',
    94	                ]);
    95	                $nb++;
    96	            }
    97	        }
    98	
    99	        return ['nb_notifications' => $nb];
   100	    }
   101	
   102	    // Lien WhatsApp pour une échéance
   103	    public static function lienWhatsapp(Echeance $echeance): string
   104	    {
   105	        $tel = $echeance->vente->debiteur?->telephone;
   106	        if (!$tel) return '';
   107	        $nom = $echeance->vente->debiteur?->nom ?? 'Client';
   108	        $msg = "Bonjour $nom,\nNous vous rappelons votre échéance de "
   109	            . number_format($echeance->montant_prevu, 0, ',', ' ')
   110	            . " FCFA.\nRestant dû : "
   111	            . number_format($echeance->restant(), 0, ',', ' ')
   112	            . " FCFA.\nMerci de procéder au règlement.\nSourougnon";
   113	        return 'https://wa.me/' . preg_replace('/[^0-9]/', '', $tel) . '?text=' . urlencode($msg);
   114	    }
   115	    /**
   116	     * Notifier la gérante et le chef d'agence d'une nouvelle vente.
   117	     */
   118	    public static function notifierNouvelleVente(\App\Models\Vente $vente): void
   119	    {
   120	        try {
   121	            $debiteur = $vente->debiteur;
   122	            $typeVente = $vente->type_vente === 'comptant' ? 'comptant' : 'crédit';
   123	            $message = 'Nouvelle vente ' . $typeVente . ' : ' . ($debiteur?->nom ?? 'Client') .
   124	                       ' pour ' . number_format($vente->montant_total, 0, ',', ' ') . ' FCFA.';
   125	
   126	            // Destinataires : gérante et chef d'agence actifs

   128	                ->where('actif', true)
   129	                ->get();
   130	
   131	            foreach ($destinataires as $user) {

   134	                    'user_id' => $user->id,
   135	                    'type' => 'vente',

   137	                    'message' => $message,
   138	                    'lien' => '#ventes',
   139	                ]);
   140	            }
   141	        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
   142	            // Ne jamais faire échouer la vente pour une simple notification

>>> app/Services/PaiementService.php
     1	<?php
     2	
     3	namespace App\Services;
     4	
     5	use App\Models\Recouvrement;
     6	use App\Models\Echeance;
     7	use App\Models\Vente;
     8	
     9	class PaiementService
    10	{
    11	    /**
    12	     * Traiter un paiement selon le statut choisi par l'agent.
    13	     * Gère les excédents : un paiement peut couvrir plusieurs échéances.
    14	     */
    15	    public static function affecterPaiement(Recouvrement $recouvrement): void
    16	    {
    17	        $vente = $recouvrement->vente;
    18	        $aujourdhui = now()->toDateString();
    19	
    20	        // Statuts non payants : absent, refus, promesse
    21	        if (!in_array($recouvrement->statut, ['paye', 'partiel'])) {
    22	            $echeance = Echeance::where('vente_id', $vente->id)
    23	                ->whereDate('date_echeance', $aujourdhui)
    24	                ->first()
    25	                ?? Echeance::where('vente_id', $vente->id)
    26	                    ->whereIn('statut', ['en_attente', 'en_retard', 'partiel'])
    27	                    ->orderBy('date_echeance')
    28	                    ->first();
    29	
    30	            if ($echeance) {
    31	                $echeance->statut = match ($recouvrement->statut) {
    32	                    'absent' => 'absent',
    33	                    'refus' => 'refus',
    34	                    'promesse' => 'promesse',
    35	                    default => $echeance->statut,
    36	                };
    37	                $echeance->save();
    38	            }
    39	
    40	            $vente->mettreAJourStatutGlobal();
    41	            return;
    42	        }
    43	
    44	        // Paiements réels : paye ou partiel
    45	        $montantRestant = $recouvrement->montant;
    46	
    47	        // 1. Échéances échues non soldées (retards)
    48	        $echeancesDues = Echeance::where('vente_id', $vente->id)
    49	            ->whereIn('statut', ['en_retard', 'partiel', 'en_attente'])
    50	            ->whereDate('date_echeance', '<=', $aujourdhui)
    51	            ->orderBy('date_echeance')
    52	            ->get();
    53	
    54	        foreach ($echeancesDues as $echeance) {
    55	            if ($montantRestant <= 0) break;
    56	            $reste = $echeance->restant();
    57	            if ($reste <= 0) continue;
    58	
    59	            $payer = min($montantRestant, $reste);
    60	            $echeance->montant_paye += $payer;
    61	            $echeance->date_paiement = $recouvrement->date_recouvrement;
    62	            $echeance->jours_retard = 0;
    63	            $echeance->statut = $echeance->montant_paye >= $echeance->montant_prevu ? 'paye' : 'partiel';
    64	            $echeance->save();
    65	
    66	            $montantRestant -= $payer;
    67	        }
    68	
    69	        // 2. Excédent vers les échéances futures
    70	        if ($montantRestant > 0) {
    71	            $echeancesFutures = Echeance::where('vente_id', $vente->id)
    72	                ->where('statut', 'en_attente')
    73	                ->whereDate('date_echeance', '>', $aujourdhui)
    74	                ->orderBy('date_echeance')
    75	                ->get();
    76	
    77	            foreach ($echeancesFutures as $echeance) {
    78	                if ($montantRestant <= 0) break;
    79	                $reste = $echeance->restant();
    80	                if ($reste <= 0) continue;
    81	
    82	                $payer = min($montantRestant, $reste);
    83	                $echeance->montant_paye += $payer;
    84	                $echeance->date_paiement = $recouvrement->date_recouvrement;
    85	                $echeance->statut = $echeance->montant_paye >= $echeance->montant_prevu ? 'paye' : 'partiel';
    86	                $echeance->save();
    87	
    88	                $montantRestant -= $payer;
    89	            }
    90	        }
    91	
    92	        // Mettre à jour le statut global de la vente
    93	        $vente->mettreAJourStatutGlobal();
    94	
    95	        // Épargne et pénalités uniquement en cas de paiement complet
    96	        if ($recouvrement->statut === 'paye') {
    97	            EpargneService::collecter($vente, $recouvrement);
    98	            PenaliteService::appliquer($vente, $recouvrement);
    99	        }
   100	    }
   101	}

     1	<?php

    14	     * Recalculer les pénalités en attente de façon idempotente.
    15	     * Une seule pénalité par échéance.
    16	     */
    17	    public static function genererEnAttente(): void
    18	    {
    19	        $aujourdhui = now()->toDateString();
    20	
    21	        $echeances = Echeance::whereDate('date_echeance', '<', $aujourdhui)
    22	            ->whereIn('statut', ['en_retard', 'partiel'])
    23	            ->get();
    24	
    25	        foreach ($echeances as $echeance) {
    26	            $jours = max(1, $echeance->date_echeance->diffInDays(now()->startOfDay()));
    27	            $montant = $jours * $echeance->vente->penalite_par_jour;
    28	
    29	            Penalite::updateOrCreate(
    30	                ['echeance_id' => $echeance->id],
    31	                [
    32	                    'vente_id'       => $echeance->vente_id,
    33	                    'debiteur_id'    => $echeance->vente->debiteur_id,
    34	                    'montant'        => $montant,
    35	                    'jours_retard'   => $jours,
    36	                    'date_appliquee' => $aujourdhui,
    37	                    'statut'         => 'en_attente',
    38	                ]
    39	            );
    40	        }
    41	    }

    57	     * Appliquer les pénalités lors d'un paiement.
    58	     */
    59	    public static function appliquer(Vente $vente, Recouvrement $recouvrement): void
    60	    {
    61	        $aujourdhui = now()->toDateString();
    62	        $echeancesRetard = Echeance::where('vente_id', $vente->id)
    63	            ->whereDate('date_echeance', '<', $aujourdhui)
    64	            ->whereNotIn('statut', ['paye'])
    65	            ->get();
    66	
    67	        foreach ($echeancesRetard as $echeance) {
    68	            $jours = $echeance->date_echeance->diffInDays(now());
    69	            if ($jours <= 0) continue;
    70	
    71	            Penalite::updateOrCreate(
    72	                ['echeance_id' => $echeance->id],
    73	                [
    74	                    'vente_id'       => $vente->id,
    75	                    'recouvrement_id' => $recouvrement->id,
    76	                    'debiteur_id'    => $vente->debiteur_id,
    77	                    'montant'        => $jours * $vente->penalite_par_jour,
    78	                    'jours_retard'   => $jours,
    79	                    'date_appliquee' => $aujourdhui,
    80	                    'statut'         => 'en_attente',
    81	                ]
    82	            );
    83	        }
    84	    }

>>> app/Services/ScoreSolvabiliteService.php
     1	<?php
     2	namespace App\Services;
     3	
     4	use App\Models\Debiteur;
     5	use App\Models\Vente;
     6	use App\Models\Echeance;
     7	use App\Models\Recouvrement;
     8	use App\Models\Penalite;
     9	use App\Models\ScoreSolvabilite;
    10	use App\Models\DerogationSolvabilite;
    11	use Illuminate\Http\Request;
    12	
    13	class ScoreSolvabiliteService
    14	{
    15	    private array $poids = [
    16	        'comportement_paiement' => 50,
    17	        'severite_retards'      => 20,
    18	        'credits_termines'     => 15,
    19	        'anciennete'           => 10,
    20	        'regularite'           => 5,
    21	    ];
    22	
    23	    public function calculer(Debiteur $debiteur): array
    24	    {
    25	        // 1. Mettre à jour proactivement les statuts des échéances du débiteur
    26	        $ventesCredit = Vente::where('debiteur_id', $debiteur->id)
    27	            ->where('type_vente', 'credit')
    28	            ->get();
    29	        
    30	        $ventesCreditIds = $ventesCredit->pluck('id');
    31	        
    32	        $echeances = Echeance::whereIn('vente_id', $ventesCreditIds)->get();
    33	        foreach ($echeances as $echeance) {
    34	            if (method_exists($echeance, 'mettreAJourStatut')) {
    35	                $echeance->mettreAJourStatut();
    36	            }
    37	        }
    38	        // Recharger la collection après mise à jour
    39	        $echeances = Echeance::whereIn('vente_id', $ventesCreditIds)->get();
    40	
    41	        $recouvrementsCredit = Recouvrement::whereIn('vente_id', $ventesCreditIds)->get();
    42	        $penalites = Penalite::where('debiteur_id', $debiteur->id)->get();
    43	
    44	        // Cold start : < 5 échéances observées
    45	        if ($echeances->count() < 5) {
    46	            return $this->scoreNeutre($debiteur, $echeances->count());
    47	        }
    48	
    49	        $comportement     = $this->calculerComportementPaiement($echeances);
    50	        $severite         = $this->calculerSeveriteRetards($echeances);
    51	        $creditsTermines = $this->calculerCreditsTermines($ventesCredit);
    52	        $anciennete       = $this->calculerAnciennete($debiteur);
    53	        $regularite       = $this->calculerRegularite($recouvrementsCredit);
    54	
    55	        $score = (
    56	            $comportement * $this->poids['comportement_paiement'] / 100 +
    57	            $severite * $this->poids['severite_retards'] / 100 +
    58	            $creditsTermines * $this->poids['credits_termines'] / 100 +
    59	            $anciennete * $this->poids['anciennete'] / 100 +
    60	            $regularite * $this->poids['regularite'] / 100
    61	        );
    62	
    63	        $score = max(0, min(100, round($score, 2)));
    64	
    65	        $details = [
    66	            'comportement_paiement' => round($comportement, 2),
    67	            'severite_retards'      => round($severite, 2),
    68	            'credits_termines'     => round($creditsTermines, 2),
    69	            'anciennete'           => round($anciennete, 2),
    70	            'regularite'           => round($regularite, 2),
    71	            'nb_echeances'          => $echeances->count(),
    72	            'nb_retards'            => $echeances->whereIn('statut', ['en_retard'])->count(),
    73	            'nb_partiels_tardifs'   => $echeances->where('statut', 'partiel')->where('date_echeance', '<', now())->count(),
    74	            'nb_penalites'          => $penalites->count(),
    75	            'poids'                 => $this->poids,
    76	        ];
    77	
    78	        ScoreSolvabilite::updateOrCreate(
    79	            ['debiteur_id' => $debiteur->id],
    80	            [
    81	                'score'                  => $score,
    82	                'nb_credits_total'       => $ventesCredit->count(),
    83	                'nb_credits_termines'    => $ventesCredit->where('statut', 'termine')->count(),
    84	                'nb_retards'             => $echeances->whereIn('statut', ['en_retard'])->count(),
    85	                'montant_total_rembourse' => $recouvrementsCredit->where('statut', 'paye')->sum('montant'),
    86	                'montant_total_du'       => $ventesCredit->sum('montant_total'),
    87	                'details_calcul'         => $details,
    88	                'historique_insuffisant' => false,
    89	                'date_calcul'            => now(),
    90	            ]
    91	        );
    92	
    93	        // Sécurisation : le score doit rester entre 0 et 100
    94	        $score = max(0, min(100, $score));
    95	        
    96	        $debiteur->score_solvabilite = $score;
    97	        $debiteur->save();
    98	
    99	        return [
   100	            'score'   => $score,
   101	            'details' => $details,
   102	            'label'   => $this->getLabel($score),
   103	        ];
   104	    }
   105	
   106	    private function scoreNeutre(Debiteur $debiteur, int $nbEcheances): array
   107	    {
   108	        ScoreSolvabilite::updateOrCreate(
   109	            ['debiteur_id' => $debiteur->id],
   110	            [
   111	                'score'                  => 50,
   112	                'historique_insuffisant' => true,
   113	                'details_calcul'         => ['raison' => 'Historique insuffisant (' . $nbEcheances . ' echeances)', 'score_neutre' => 50],
   114	                'date_calcul'            => now(),
   115	            ]
   116	        );
   117	
   118	        $debiteur->update(['score_solvabilite' => 50]);
   119	
   120	        return ['score' => 50, 'details' => ['historique_insuffisant' => true], 'label' => 'Neutre'];
   121	    }
   122	
   123	    private function calculerComportementPaiement($echeances): float
   124	    {
   125	        $score = 0;
   126	        $totalPoids = 0;
   127	        $now = now();
   128	
   129	        foreach ($echeances as $echeance) {
   130	            $joursEcoules = $echeance->date_echeance->diffInDays($now);
   131	            $poidsRecence = exp(-$joursEcoules / 90);
   132	
   133	            $scorePonctuel = match($echeance->statut) {
   134	                'paye'    => 100,
   135	                'partiel' => 50,
   136	                default   => 0,
   137	            };
   138	
   139	            $score += $scorePonctuel * $poidsRecence;
   140	            $totalPoids += $poidsRecence;
   141	        }
   142	
   143	        return $totalPoids > 0 ? $score / $totalPoids : 0;
   144	    }
   145	
   146	    private function calculerSeveriteRetards($echeances): float
   147	    {
   148	        $now = now();
   149	        $retards = $echeances->filter(function($e) use ($now) {
   150	            return $e->statut === 'en_retard' || 
   151	                   ($e->statut === 'partiel' && $e->date_echeance->isPast());
   152	        });
   153	
   154	        if ($retards->isEmpty()) return 100;
   155	
   156	        $score = 0;
   157	        $totalPoids = 0;
   158	
   159	        foreach ($retards as $retard) {
   160	            // Sévérité basée sur les jours de retard réels (stockés ou calculés)
   161	            $joursRetard = $retard->jours_retard ?: max(1, $retard->date_echeance->diffInDays($now));
   162	            
   163	            // Pondération temporelle (récence de l'échéance)
   164	            $joursDepuisEcheance = max(0, $retard->date_echeance->diffInDays($now));
   165	            $poidsRecence = exp(-$joursDepuisEcheance / 90);
   166	
   167	            // Pénalité progressive selon la durée du retard (perte de 10 points par jour de retard)
   168	            $severite = max(0, 100 - ($joursRetard * 10));
   169	            
   170	            $score += $severite * $poidsRecence;
   171	            $totalPoids += $poidsRecence;
   172	        }
   173	
   174	        return $totalPoids > 0 ? $score / $totalPoids : 0;
   175	    }
   176	
   177	    private function calculerCreditsTermines($ventesCredit): float
   178	    {
   179	        $creditsTermines = $ventesCredit->where('statut', 'termine')->count();
   180	        $ratio = min($creditsTermines / 5, 1);
   181	        return $ratio * 100;
   182	    }
   183	
   184	    private function calculerAnciennete(Debiteur $debiteur): float
   185	    {
   186	        $mois = $debiteur->created_at->diffInMonths(now());
   187	        $ratio = min($mois / 24, 1);
   188	        return $ratio * 100;
   189	    }
   190	
   191	    private function calculerRegularite($recouvrementsCredit): float
   192	    {
   193	        $montants = $recouvrementsCredit
   194	            ->where('statut', 'paye')
   195	            ->pluck('montant')
   196	            ->toArray();
   197	
   198	        if (count($montants) < 2) return 50;
   199	
   200	        $moyenne = array_sum($montants) / count($montants);
   201	        $variance = array_sum(array_map(fn($m) => pow($m - $moyenne, 2), $montants)) / count($montants);
   202	        $ecartType = sqrt($variance);
   203	
   204	        $ratio = max(0, 1 - ($ecartType / max($moyenne, 1)));
   205	        return $ratio * 100;
   206	    }
   207	
   208	    private function getLabel(float $score): string
   209	    {
   210	        if ($score >= 80) return 'Excellent';
   211	        if ($score >= 60) return 'Bon';
   212	        if ($score >= 40) return 'Moyen';
   213	        if ($score >= 20) return 'Risqué';
   214	        return 'Critique';
   215	    }
   216	
   217	    public function enregistrerDerogation(Debiteur $debiteur, $venteId, $motif, Request $request): void
   218	    {
   219	        DerogationSolvabilite::create([
   220	            'debiteur_id'      => $debiteur->id,
   221	            'vente_id'         => $venteId,
   222	            'user_id'          => $request->user()->id,
   223	            'score_au_moment'  => $debiteur->score_solvabilite ?? 0,
   224	            'motif'            => $motif,
   225	            'resultat_credit'  => 'en_cours',
   226	        ]);
   227	    }
   228	
   229	    public function mettreAJourResultatDerogation($venteId): void
   230	    {
   231	        $vente = Vente::findOrFail($venteId);
   232	        $derogation = DerogationSolvabilite::where('vente_id', $venteId)->first();
   233	        if (!$derogation) return;
   234	
   235	        if ($vente->statut === 'termine') {
   236	            $aDesRetards = Echeance::where('vente_id', $venteId)
   237	                ->where(function($q) {
   238	                    $q->where('statut', 'en_retard')
   239	                      ->orWhere(function($q2) {
   240	                          $q2->where('statut', 'partiel')
   241	                             ->where('date_echeance', '<', now());
   242	                      });
   243	                })
   244	                ->exists();
   245	            $derogation->resultat_credit = $aDesRetards ? 'termine_avec_retard' : 'termine_sans_retard';
   246	        } elseif ($vente->statut === 'annule') {
   247	            $derogation->resultat_credit = 'defaut';
   248	        }
   249	        $derogation->save();
   250	    }

>>> app/Services/SyntheseService.php
     1	<?php
     2	namespace App\Services;
     3	use App\Models\SyntheseJournaliere;
     4	use App\Models\Vente;
     5	use App\Models\Recouvrement;
     6	use App\Models\User;
     7	
     8	class SyntheseService
     9	{
    10	    public static function generer(): void
    11	    {
    12	        $aujourdhui = now()->toDateString();
    13	        $agents = User::where('role', 'agent')->where('actif', true)->get();
    14	        foreach ($agents as $agent) {
    15	            $ventes = Vente::where('agent_id', $agent->id)
    16	                ->where('statut', 'en_cours')
    17	                ->whereDate('date_debut', '<=', $aujourdhui)
    18	                ->whereDate('date_fin', '>=', $aujourdhui);
    19	            $attendu = $ventes->sum('montant_journalier');
    20	            $encaisse = Recouvrement::where('agent_id', $agent->id)
    21	                ->where('statut', 'paye')
    22	                ->whereDate('date_recouvrement', $aujourdhui)
    23	                ->sum('montant');
    24	            SyntheseJournaliere::updateOrCreate(
    25	                ['date' => $aujourdhui, 'agent_id' => $agent->id],
    26	                [
    27	                    'nb_debiteurs' => $ventes->distinct('debiteur_id')->count('debiteur_id'),
    28	                    'montant_attendu' => $attendu,
    29	                    'montant_encaisse' => $encaisse,
    30	                    'montant_impaye' => max(0, $attendu - $encaisse),
    31	                    'taux_recouvrement' => $attendu > 0 ? round(($encaisse / $attendu) * 100, 2) : 0,
    32	                ]
    33	            );
    34	        }
    35	    }
    36	}

>>> app/Console/Commands/RecalculerPenalites.php
     1	<?php
     2	
     3	namespace App\Console\Commands;
     4	
     5	use Illuminate\Console\Command;
     6	use App\Models\Echeance;
     7	use App\Services\PenaliteService;
     8	
     9	class RecalculerPenalites extends Command
    10	{
    11	    protected $signature = 'penalites:recalculer';
    12	    protected $description = 'Met à jour les statuts des échéances et recalcule les pénalités en attente';
    13	
    14	    public function handle()
    15	    {
    16	        $this->info('Mise à jour des échéances échues...');
    17	
    18	        Echeance::whereDate('date_echeance', '<', today())
    19	            ->whereNotIn('statut', ['paye', 'annule'])
    20	            ->chunkById(200, function ($lot) {
    21	                foreach ($lot as $e) {
    22	                    $e->mettreAJourStatut();
    23	                }
    24	            });
    25	
    26	        PenaliteService::genererEnAttente();
    27	        PenaliteService::genererPenalitesRetardPaye();
    28	
    29	        $this->info('Pénalités recalculées.');
    30	        return 0;
    31	    }
    32	}

>>> app/Console/Commands/UpdateEcheancesStatut.php
     1	<?php
     2	
     3	namespace App\Console\Commands;
     4	
     5	use Illuminate\Console\Command;
     6	use App\Models\Echeance;
     7	use App\Services\ScoreSolvabiliteService;
     8	
     9	class UpdateEcheancesStatut extends Command
    10	{
    11	    protected $signature = 'echeances:update-statut';
    12	    protected $description = 'Mettre à jour le statut et les jours de retard de toutes les échéances';
    13	
    14	    public function handle(): int
    15	    {
    16	        $echeances = Echeance::whereIn('statut', ['en_attente', 'partiel', 'en_retard'])
    17	            ->where('date_echeance', '<', now())
    18	            ->with('vente.debiteur')
    19	            ->get();
    20	
    21	        $count = 0;
    22	        $debiteurs = collect();
    23	
    24	        foreach ($echeances as $echeance) {
    25	            if (method_exists($echeance, 'mettreAJourStatut')) {
    26	                $echeance->mettreAJourStatut();
    27	                $count++;
    28	
    29	                $debiteur = $echeance->vente->debiteur ?? null;
    30	                if ($debiteur) {
    31	                    $debiteurs->put($debiteur->id, $debiteur);
    32	                }
    33	            }
    34	        }
    35	
    36	        foreach ($debiteurs as $debiteur) {
    37	            try {
    38	                app(ScoreSolvabiliteService::class)->calculer($debiteur);
    39	            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
    40	                $this->error("Erreur recalcul score pour débiteur {$debiteur->id}: {$e->getMessage()}");
    41	            }
    42	        }
    43	
    44	        $this->info("Statuts mis à jour pour {$count} échéance(s) et scores recalculés pour {$debiteurs->count()} débiteur(s).");
    45	        return Command::SUCCESS;
    46	    }
    47	}

CREATE TABLE `agences` (
`id` int(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
`uuid` varchar(36) DEFAULT NULL,
`nom` varchar(150) DEFAULT NULL,
`adresse` text DEFAULT NULL,
`telephone` varchar(20) DEFAULT NULL,

`created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT current_timestamp(),
`updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
UNIQUE KEY `uuid` (`uuid`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=2 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

    46	      const err = document.getElementById('loginError');

>>> public/agent-app/app.js
     1	const AgentApp = {
     2	  API: 'https://sourougnon.alwaysdata.net',
     3	  token: localStorage.getItem('agent_token'),
     4	  user: JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('agent_user') || '{}'),
     5	  tourneeData: JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('agent_tournee_cache') || 'null'),
     6	  debiteursData: JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('agent_debiteurs_cache') || '[]'),
     7	  currentTab: 'tous',
     8	  currentVente: null,
     9	  currentClient: null,
    10	  tourneeEnCours: false,
    11	  _submitLock: false,
    12	  _syncing: false,
    13	
    14	  async login(identifiant, password) {
    15	    try {
    16	      const res = await fetch(this.API + '/api/auth/login', {
    17	        method: 'POST',
    18	        headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
    19	        body: JSON.stringify({identifiant, password, role: 'agent'})
    20	      });
    21	      const data = await res.json();
    22	      if (data.token) {
    23	        localStorage.setItem('agent_token', data.token);
    24	        localStorage.setItem('agent_user', JSON.stringify(data.user || {}));
    25	        this.token = data.token;
    26	        this.user = data.user || {};
    27	        return {success: true};
    28	      }
    29	      return {error: data.error || 'Erreur de connexion'};
    30	    } catch (e) {
    31	      return {error: 'Réseau indisponible'};
    32	    }
    33	  },
    34	
    35	  logout() {
    36	    localStorage.removeItem('agent_token');
    37	    localStorage.removeItem('agent_user');
    38	    localStorage.removeItem('agent_tournee_cache');
    39	    localStorage.removeItem('agent_debiteurs_cache');
    40	    window.location.href = 'login.html';
    41	  },
    42	
    43	  async _call(path, options = {}) {
    44	    let res;
    45	    try {
    46	      res = await fetch(this.API + '/api' + path, {
    47	        ...options,
    48	        headers: {
    49	          ...(options.headers || {}),
    50	          'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + (this.token || ''),
    51	          'Accept': 'application/json'
    52	        }
    53	      });
    54	    } catch (e) {
    55	      return { error: 'Hors ligne ou réseau indisponible', networkError: true };
    56	    }
    57	
    58	    if (res.status === 401) {
    59	      this.logout();
    60	      return { error: 'Session expirée' };
    61	    }
    62	
    63	    try {
    64	      const data = await res.json();
    65	      if (!res.ok) {
    66	        return { error: data.message || data.error || 'Erreur ' + res.status, httpError: res.status };
    67	      }
    68	      return data;
    69	    } catch (e) {
    70	      return { error: 'Réponse invalide du serveur', httpError: res.status };
    71	    }
    72	  },
    73	
    74	  async apiGet(path) {
    75	    const data = await this._call(path);
    76	    if (data && !data.error) {
    77	      try { await window.SourougnonDB.setCached(path, data); } catch (e) {}
    78	      return data;
    79	    }
    80	    // Réseau mort ou erreur : tentative cache
    81	    try {
    82	      const cached = await window.SourougnonDB.getCached(path);
    83	      if (cached) return cached;
    84	    } catch (e) {}
    85	    return data;
    86	  },
    87	
    88	  apiPost(path, body) {
    89	    return this._call(path, {
    90	      method: 'POST',
    91	      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    92	      body: JSON.stringify(body)
    93	    });
    94	  },
    95	
    96	  async apiPostOrQueue(path, body) {
    97	    // Idempotence : générer un sync_uuid unique et stable pour cette opération
    98	    if (!body.sync_uuid) {
    99	      body.sync_uuid = (crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : 'sync-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2));
   100	    }
   101	
   102	    if (navigator.onLine) {
   103	      const res = await this.apiPost(path, body);
   104	      if (!res.networkError) {
   105	        return res;
   106	      }
   107	      // Réseau mort détecté, on retombe dans la file
   108	    }
   109	
   110	    try {
   111	      const op = {
   112	        endpoint: path,
   113	        body: body,
   114	        createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
   115	        synced: false
   116	      };
   117	      const id = await window.SourougnonDB.addPending(op);
   118	      console.log('Opération mise en attente hors ligne:', id, path, body.sync_uuid);
   119	      return { success: true, offline: true, message: 'Opération enregistrée localement. Synchronisation requise.' };
   120	    } catch (e) {
   121	      console.error('Erreur IndexedDB:', e);
   122	      return { error: 'Impossible de sauvegarder hors ligne.' };
   123	    }
   124	  },
   125	
   126	  async confirmClearPending() {
   127	    const pending = await window.SourougnonDB.getAllPending();
   128	    if (pending.length === 0) {
   129	      this.ui.showAlert('Aucune opération en attente.');
   130	      return;
   131	    }
   132	    const ok = await this.ui.confirm(`Vider la file d'attente ? (${pending.length} opération(s) seront perdues.)`);
   133	    if (!ok) return;
   134	    await window.SourougnonDB.clearPending();
   135	    this.ui.showAlert('File purgée.');
   136	    await this.loadTournee();
   137	  },
   138	
   139	  async syncAll() {
   140	    if (this._syncing) return false;
   141	    if (!navigator.onLine) {
   142	      this.ui.showAlert('Hors ligne. Synchronisation impossible.');
   143	      return false;
   144	    }
   145	
   146	    this._syncing = true;
   147	    try {
   148	      const pending = await window.SourougnonDB.getAllPending();
   149	      if (pending.length === 0) {
   150	        this.ui.showAlert('Aucune opération en attente.');
   151	        return true;
   152	      }
   153	      let successCount = 0;
   154	      for (const op of pending) {
   155	        try {
   156	          const res = await this.apiPost(op.endpoint, op.body);
   157	          if (res.error) {
   158	            console.warn('Sync échouée pour', op.endpoint, res.error);
   159	          } else {
   160	            await window.SourougnonDB.deletePending(op.id);
   161	            successCount++;
   162	          }
   163	        } catch (e) {
   164	          console.error('Erreur réseau pendant sync:', e);
   165	          break;
   166	        }
   167	      }
   168	      const remaining = await window.SourougnonDB.getAllPending();
   169	      if (remaining.length === 0) {
   170	        this.ui.showAlert('Synchronisation terminée : ' + successCount + ' opération(s) envoyée(s).');
   171	      } else {
   172	        this.ui.showAlert('Synchronisation partielle : ' + successCount + ' envoyée(s), ' + remaining.length + ' restante(s).');
   173	      }
   174	      await this.loadTournee();
   175	      await this.loadDebiteurs();
   176	      return remaining.length === 0;
   177	    } finally {
   178	      this._syncing = false;
   179	    }
   180	  },
   181	
   182	  showHome() { this.showScreen('home'); },
   183	
   184	  async cacheDebiteurs(list) {
   185	    try {
   186	      const db = await openDB();
   187	      const tx = db.transaction('debiteurs', 'readwrite');
   188	      const store = tx.objectStore('debiteurs');
   189	      if (!store) return;
   190	      for (const d of list) {
   191	        store.put(d);
   192	      }
   193	    } catch (e) {}
   194	  },
   195	
   196	  async getDebiteurLocal(uuid) {
   197	    try {
   198	      const db = await openDB();
   199	      const tx = db.transaction('debiteurs', 'readonly');
   200	      const store = tx.objectStore('debiteurs');
   201	      if (!store) return null;
   202	      const req = store.get(uuid);
   203	      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   204	        req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result || null);
   205	        req.onerror = () => resolve(null);
   206	      });
   207	    } catch (e) { return null; }
   208	  },
   209	
   210	  async getAllDebiteursLocal() {
   211	    try {
   212	      const db = await openDB();
   213	      const tx = db.transaction('debiteurs', 'readonly');
   214	      const store = tx.objectStore('debiteurs');
   215	      if (!store) return [];
   216	      const req = store.getAll();
   217	      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   218	        req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result || []);
   219	        req.onerror = () => resolve([]);
   220	      });
   221	    } catch (e) { return []; }
   222	  },
   223	
   224	
   225	  async init() {
   226	    if (!this.token) { window.location.href = 'login.html'; return; }
   227	    if (this.user.nom) {
   228	      document.getElementById('greeting').textContent = 'Bonjour ' + this.user.nom + ' ' + (this.user.prenom || '') + ' 👋';
   229	      document.getElementById('userInitials').textContent = (this.user.nom?.[0] || 'A') + (this.user.prenom?.[0] || 'G');
   230	    }
   231	    this.setToday();
   232	    await this.preloadAllData();
   233	    await this.loadTournee();
   234	    await this.loadTourneeStatut();
   235	    this.showHome();
   236	  },

   249	  renderTourneeButton() {
   250	    const btn = document.getElementById('btnToggleTournee');
   251	    if (!btn) return;
   252	    if (this.tourneeEnCours) {
   253	      btn.textContent = '✓ Terminer la tournée';
   254	      btn.classList.remove('cta--blue');
   255	      btn.classList.add('cta--green');
   256	    } else {
   257	      btn.textContent = '➤ Démarrer la tournée';
   258	      btn.classList.add('cta--blue');
   259	      btn.classList.remove('cta--green');

   263	  async _obtenirPosition() {
   264	    // Essaie la géolocalisation automatique
   265	    const position = await new Promise((resolve) => {
   266	      if (!navigator.geolocation) return resolve(null);
   267	      const timeout = setTimeout(() => resolve(null), 8000);
   268	      navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
   269	        (pos) => {
   270	          clearTimeout(timeout);
   271	          resolve(pos.coords.latitude.toFixed(6) + ',' + pos.coords.longitude.toFixed(6));
   272	        },
   273	        () => {
   274	          clearTimeout(timeout);
   275	          resolve(null);
   276	        },
   277	        { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 8000, maximumAge: 60000 }
   278	      );
   279	    });
   280	
   281	    if (position) return position;
   282	
   283	    // Fallback manuel si GPS indisponible ou refusé
   284	    const manuel = await (this.ui.prompt ? this.ui.prompt('Coordonnées GPS (latitude, longitude) :', '') : prompt('Coordonnées GPS (latitude, longitude) :', ''));
   285	    if (manuel && /^-?\d+(\.\d+)?\s*,\s*-?\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(manuel)) {
   286	      return manuel.replace(/\s/g, '');
   287	    }
   288	    return null;
   289	  },
   290	
   291	  async toggleTournee() {
   292	    // Si on tente de terminer la tournée, vérifier qu'il ne reste aucune visite à traiter
   293	    if (this.tourneeEnCours) {
   294	      const aVisiter = (this.tourneeData && this.tourneeData.a_visiter) || [];
   295	      if (aVisiter.length > 0) {
   296	        this.ui.showAlert(`Impossible de terminer la tournée : ${aVisiter.length} visite(s) restante(s). Traitez-les d'abord.`);
   297	        return;
   298	      }
   299	    }
   300	
   301	    // Obtenir la position GPS (non bloquant)
   302	    const position = await this._obtenirPosition();
   303	
   304	    const endpoint = this.tourneeEnCours ? '/agent/tournee/terminer' : '/agent/tournee/demarrer';
   305	    const body = {
   306	      sync_uuid: crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : 'sync-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2),
   307	    };
   308	
   309	    if (this.tourneeEnCours) {
   310	      if (position) body.gps_arrivee = position;
   311	    } else {
   312	      if (position) body.gps_depart = position;
   313	    }
   314	
   315	    const res = await this.apiPostOrQueue(endpoint, body);
   316	    if (res.error) { this.ui.showAlert(res.error); return; }
   317	    this.tourneeEnCours = !this.tourneeEnCours;
   318	    this.renderTourneeButton();
   319	    this.ui.showAlert(res.offline ? 'Tournée enregistrée localement. Synchronisation requise.' : (this.tourneeEnCours ? 'Tournée démarrée.' : 'Tournée terminée.'));
   320	  },

   322	  async loadTournee() {
   323	    // Si hors ligne et cache dispo, utiliser le cache
   324	    if (!navigator.onLine && this.tourneeData) {
   325	      this.renderHomeKPIs();
   326	      this.renderHomeList();
   327	      return;
   328	    }
   329	    const d = await this.apiGet('/agent-space/tournee');
   330	    if (d.error) {
   331	      if (this.tourneeData) {
   332	        this.renderHomeKPIs();
   333	        this.renderHomeList();
   334	        this.ui.showAlert('Hors ligne. Affichage de la dernière tournée.');
   335	      } else {
   336	        this.ui.showAlert('Impossible de charger la tournée.');
   337	      }
   338	      return;
   339	    }
   340	    this.tourneeData = d;
   341	    localStorage.setItem('agent_tournee_cache', JSON.stringify(d));
   342	    this.renderHomeKPIs();
   343	    this.renderHomeList();
   344	  },

   346	  async preloadAllData() {
   347	    const res = await this.apiGet('/agent/bootstrap');
   348	    if (!res || res.error) {
   349	      console.warn('Bootstrap indisponible, préchargement classique');
   350	      await this._legacyPreload();
   351	      return;
   352	    }
   353	
   354	    const cache = window.SourougnonDB;
   355	    const set = (k, v) => v !== undefined ? cache.setCached(k, v) : Promise.resolve();
   356	
   357	    await Promise.all([
   358	      set('/agent-space/tournee', res.tournee),
   359	      set('/agent/debiteurs', res.debiteurs),
   360	      set('/agent/epargnes', res.epargnes),
   361	      set('/agent/penalites', res.penalites),
   362	      set('/agent/tournee/statut', res.statut_tournee),
   363	      set('/notifications', res.notifications),
   364	      set('/auth/me', { user: res.user }),
   365	      set('archives:' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0,7), res.archives_courant),
   366	    ]);
   367	
   368	    // Précharger les détails des débiteurs
   369	    if (Array.isArray(res.debiteurs)) {
   370	      for (const d of res.debiteurs) {
   371	        try {
   372	          const detail = await this.apiGet('/agent/debiteurs/' + d.uuid);
   373	          if (!detail.error) {
   374	            await cache.setCached('/agent/debiteurs/' + d.uuid, detail);
   375	          }
   376	        } catch (e) {}
   377	      }
   378	    }
   379	    console.log('✅ Bootstrap préchargé');
   380	  },
   381	
   382	  async _legacyPreload() {
   383	    const endpoints = [
   384	      '/agent-space/tournee',
   385	      '/agent/debiteurs',
   386	      '/agent/epargnes',
   387	      '/agent/penalites',
   388	      '/notifications',
   389	      '/agent/tournee/statut',
   390	      '/auth/me',
   391	    ];
   392	
   393	    for (const endpoint of endpoints) {
   394	      try {
   395	        const data = await this.apiGet(endpoint);
   396	        if (!data.error) {
   397	          await window.SourougnonDB.setCached(endpoint, data);
   398	        }
   399	      } catch (e) {}
   400	    }
   401	  },

   410	    }

   412	    if (!d.error) {
   413	      this.debiteursData = d;
   414	      try { await window.SourougnonDB.setCached('/agent/debiteurs', d); } catch(e) {}
   415	    }
   416	  },

   441	  renderHomeList() {
   442	    const d = this.tourneeData || {};
   443	    const all = [...(d.a_visiter || []), ...(d.paye || []), ...(d.absent || []), ...(d.refus || []), ...(d.promesse || [])];
   444	    const filters = ['tous', 'a_visiter', 'paye', 'retard', 'absent', 'refus', 'promesse'];
   445	    const labels = {'tous':'Tous','a_visiter':'À visiter','paye':'Payés','retard':'Retards','absent':'Absents','refus':'Refus','promesse':'Promesses'};
   446	    document.getElementById('homeFilters').innerHTML = filters.map(f => {
   447	      let count = 0;
   448	      if (f === 'tous') count = all.length;
   449	      else if (f === 'retard') count = all.filter(v => v.statut_global === 'en_retard').length;
   450	      else if (f === 'paye') count = all.filter(v => v.statut_visite === 'paye').length;
   451	      else if (f === 'absent') count = all.filter(v => v.statut_visite === 'absent').length;
   452	      else if (f === 'refus') count = all.filter(v => v.statut_visite === 'refus').length;
   453	      else if (f === 'promesse') count = all.filter(v => v.statut_visite === 'promesse').length;
   454	      else count = all.filter(v => !['paye','absent','refus','promesse'].includes(v.statut_visite)).length;
   455	      return `<button class="chip ${f===this.currentTab?'chip--active':''}" data-filter="${f}">${labels[f]} <span>${count}</span></button>`;
   456	    }).join('');
   457	
   458	    document.querySelectorAll('#homeFilters .chip').forEach(chip => {
   459	      chip.addEventListener('click', () => {
   460	        this.currentTab = chip.dataset.filter;
   461	        this.renderHomeList();
   462	      });
   463	    });
   464	
   465	    const filtered = this.filterHome(all);
   466	    const money = v => new Intl.NumberFormat('fr-FR', {style:'currency', currency:'XOF', maximumFractionDigits:0}).format(v||0);
   467	    document.getElementById('clientList').innerHTML = filtered.length === 0
   468	      ? '<p class="muted" style="text-align:center;padding:20px;">Aucun client</p>'
   469	      : filtered.map(v => {
   470	          let statutClass = 'status--success';
   471	          let statutTexte = 'À jour';
   472	          if (v.statut_global === 'en_retard') { statutClass = 'status--danger'; statutTexte = 'En retard'; }
   473	          else if (v.statut_visite === 'paye') { statutTexte = 'Payé'; }
   474	          else if (v.statut_visite === 'absent') { statutTexte = 'Absent'; statutClass = 'status--warning'; }
   475	          else if (v.statut_visite === 'refus') { statutTexte = 'Refus'; statutClass = 'status--warning'; }
   476	          else if (v.statut_visite === 'promesse') { statutTexte = 'Promesse'; statutClass = 'status--warning'; }
   477	          else { statutTexte = 'À visiter'; statutClass = 'status--warning'; }
   478	          return `<article class="client-card">
   479	            <div class="avatar avatar--blue">${v.debiteur?.charAt(0) || '?'}${v.debiteur?.charAt(v.debiteur.indexOf(' ')+1) || ''}</div>
   480	            <div class="client-card__main">
   481	              <div class="client-card__title">
   482	                <div><h3>${v.debiteur}</h3><p>${v.quartier || '-'}</p></div>
   483	                <span class="status ${statutClass}">${statutTexte}</span>
   484	              </div>
   485	              <div class="client-card__meta"><span>📞 ${v.telephone || '-'}</span></div>
   486	              <div class="client-card__bottom">
   487	                <strong>${money(v.montant_journalier)}</strong>
   488	                <button class="small-btn small-btn--primary" ${v.peut_encaisser === false ? 'disabled style="opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed;"' : ''} onclick='AgentApp.openVenteFromTournee(${JSON.stringify(v)})'>${v.peut_encaisser === false ? 'Déjà payé' : 'Voir client'}</button>
   489	              </div>
   490	            </div>
   491	          </article>`;
   492	        }).join('');
   493	  },

   495	  filterHome(all) {
   496	    if (this.currentTab === 'tous') return all;
   497	    if (this.currentTab === 'retard') return all.filter(v => v.statut_global === 'en_retard');
   498	    if (this.currentTab === 'paye') return all.filter(v => v.statut_visite === 'paye');
   499	    if (this.currentTab === 'absent') return all.filter(v => v.statut_visite === 'absent');
   500	    if (this.currentTab === 'refus') return all.filter(v => v.statut_visite === 'refus');
   501	    if (this.currentTab === 'promesse') return all.filter(v => v.statut_visite === 'promesse');
   502	    return all.filter(v => !['paye','absent','refus','promesse'].includes(v.statut_visite));
   503	  },

   518	    } catch (e) {}

   532	    this.currentClient = deb;
   533	    this.currentVente = deb.ventes && deb.ventes.length > 0 ? deb.ventes.find(v => v.statut === 'en_cours') : null;
   534	    this.renderClientDetail(deb);

   538	  renderClientDetail(deb) {
   539	    const money = v => new Intl.NumberFormat('fr-FR', {style:'currency', currency:'XOF', maximumFractionDigits:0}).format(v||0);

   544	      ? '<p class="muted">Aucune vente</p>'

   549	          return `<div class="info-card">
   550	            <div class="info-row"><span>Type</span><strong>${v.type_vente === 'credit' ? 'Crédit' : 'Comptant'}</strong></div>
   551	            <div class="info-row"><span>Montant total</span><strong>${money(v.montant_total)}</strong></div>
   552	            <div class="info-row"><span>Payé</span><strong>${money(v.total_paye || 0)}</strong></div>
   553	            <div class="info-row"><span>Restant</span><strong>${money(v.reste_a_payer || 0)}</strong></div>
   554	            <div class="info-row"><span>Jours payés</span><strong>${v.jours_payes || 0}/${v.jours_total || 0}</strong></div>
   555	            <div class="info-row"><span>Statut</span><strong>${v.statut}</strong></div>
   556	            <ul>${produits}</ul>
   557	          </div>`;
   558	        }).join('');
   559	
   560	    document.getElementById('clientDetail').innerHTML = `
   561	      <div class="profile-card">
   562	        <div class="avatar avatar--xl avatar--blue">${initial}</div>
   563	        <div><h2>${deb.nom} ${deb.prenom || ''}</h2><p class="muted">${deb.activite || '-'}</p><span class="status status--success">Client actif</span></div>
   564	        <div class="hero-banner__score"><span class="hero-banner__score-label">Score</span><strong>${score}</strong></div>

   647	  async submitEncaisser(e) {
   648	    e.preventDefault();
   649	    if (this._submitLock) return;
   650	    if (!this.currentVente) { this.ui.showAlert('Aucune vente sélectionnée'); return; }
   651	
   652	    this._submitLock = true;
   653	    const btn = document.querySelector('#collectionForm button[type="submit"]');
   654	    if (btn) { btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Enregistrement…'; }
   655	
   656	    try {
   657	      const data = {
   658	        vente_id: this.currentVente.uuid,
   659	        montant: parseFloat(document.getElementById('amount').value) || 0,
   660	        mode_paiement: document.getElementById('paymentMode').value,
   661	        statut: document.getElementById('paymentStatus').value,
   662	        commentaire: document.getElementById('comment').value,
   663	        sync_uuid: crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : 'sync-' + Date.now() + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2),
   664	      };
   665	
   666	      const res = await this.apiPostOrQueue('/agent-space/encaisser', data);
   667	      if (res.error) { this.ui.showAlert(res.error); return; }
   668	      if (res.offline) {
   669	        this.ui.showAlert('Paiement enregistré localement.');
   670	      } else {
   671	        this.showSuccess(res, data);
   672	      }
   673	      await this.loadTournee();
   674	    } finally {
   675	      this._submitLock = false;
   676	      if (btn) { btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = '✓ Valider le paiement'; }
   677	    }
   678	  },

   684	      <div><small>Date</small><strong>${new Intl.DateTimeFormat('fr-FR', {day:'2-digit', month:'long', year:'numeric', hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'}).format(new Date())}</strong></div>

   706	  async openEpargnes() {
   707	    const list = await this.apiGet('/agent/epargnes');
   708	    if (list.error) { this.ui.showAlert(list.error); return; }
   709	    const money = v => new Intl.NumberFormat('fr-FR', {style:'currency', currency:'XOF', maximumFractionDigits:0}).format(v||0);
   710	
   711	    const positives = list.filter(e => parseFloat(e.montant || 0) > 0);
   712	    const negatives = list.filter(e => parseFloat(e.montant || 0) < 0);
   713	    const totalCollecte = positives.reduce((sum, e) => sum + parseFloat(e.montant || 0), 0);
   714	    const totalDefalques = Math.abs(negatives.reduce((sum, e) => sum + parseFloat(e.montant || 0), 0));

   717	      <div class="stats-grid">
   718	        <div class="metric-card"><div class="metric-card__icon metric-card__icon--green">₣</div><div><span>Épargne collectée</span><strong>${money(totalCollecte)}</strong></div></div>
   719	        <div class="metric-card"><div class="metric-card__icon metric-card__icon--red">−</div><div><span>Défalques pénalités</span><strong>${money(totalDefalques)}</strong></div></div>
   720	        <div class="metric-card"><div class="metric-card__icon metric-card__icon--blue">✓</div><div><span>Collectes</span><strong>${positives.length}</strong></div></div>
   721	      </div>
   722	
   723	      <h3 class="section-title" style="margin-top:18px;">Collectes</h3>
   724	      <div class="client-list">
   725	        ${positives.length === 0 ? '<p class="muted" style="text-align:center;padding:20px;">Aucune collecte</p>' :
   726	          positives.map(e => `
   727	            <div class="client-card">
   728	              <div class="avatar avatar--green">${(e.debiteur?.nom?.[0] || '')}${(e.debiteur?.prenom?.[0] || '')}</div>
   729	              <div class="client-card__main">
   730	                <div class="client-card__title">
   731	                  <div><h3>${e.debiteur?.nom} ${e.debiteur?.prenom}</h3><p>${new Date(e.date_collecte).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR')}</p></div>
   732	                  <span class="status status--success">Collectée</span>
   733	                </div>
   734	                <strong>${money(e.montant)}</strong>
   735	                ${e.statut === 'a_restituer' ? `<button class="small-btn small-btn--primary" style="margin-top:6px;" onclick="AgentApp.restituerEpargne('${e.uuid}')">Restituer</button>` : ''}
   736	              </div>
   737	            </div>`).join('')
   738	        }
   739	      </div>
   740	
   741	      <h3 class="section-title" style="margin-top:18px;">Défalques de pénalités</h3>
   742	      <div class="client-list">
   743	        ${negatives.length === 0 ? '<p class="muted" style="text-align:center;padding:20px;">Aucun débit</p>' :
   744	          negatives.map(e => `
   745	            <div class="client-card">
   746	              <div class="avatar avatar--red">${(e.debiteur?.nom?.[0] || '')}${(e.debiteur?.prenom?.[0] || '')}</div>
   747	              <div class="client-card__main">
   748	                <div class="client-card__title">
   749	                  <div><h3>${e.debiteur?.nom} ${e.debiteur?.prenom}</h3><p>${new Date(e.date_collecte).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR')}</p></div>
   750	                  <span class="status status--danger">Défalque</span>
   751	                </div>
   752	                <strong style="color:var(--red);">−${money(Math.abs(e.montant))}</strong>
   753	              </div>
   754	            </div>`).join('')
   755	        }
   756	      </div>
   757	    `;
   758	    this.showScreen('epargnes');

   864	  async soumettreRemise() {
   865	    const encours = await this.apiGet('/agent/encaissements-attente');
   866	    const total = (Array.isArray(encours) ? encours : []).reduce((s, m) => s + parseFloat(m.montant || 0), 0);

   881	      this.ui.showAlert(res.error);

   889	  async openArchives() {
   890	    if (!this.currentArchiveMonth) {

   895	  },
   896	
   897	  async changeArchiveMonth(delta) {
   898	    await this.loadArchiveMonth(delta);
   899	  },
   900	
   901	  async loadArchiveMonth(delta = 0) {
   902	    if (!this.currentArchiveMonth) this.currentArchiveMonth = new Date();
   903	    this.currentArchiveMonth.setMonth(this.currentArchiveMonth.getMonth() + delta);
   904	
   905	    const year = this.currentArchiveMonth.getFullYear();
   906	    const month = String(this.currentArchiveMonth.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
   907	    const mois = `${year}-${month}`;
   908	    const cacheKey = 'archives:' + mois;
   909	
   910	    let data = null;
   911	    if (!navigator.onLine) {
   912	      data = await window.SourougnonDB.getCached(cacheKey);
   913	      if (!data) {
   914	        this.ui.showAlert('Archives non disponibles hors-ligne pour ce mois.');
   915	        return;
   916	      }
   917	    } else {
   918	      const res = await this.apiGet('/agent/archives?mois=' + mois);
   919	      if (res.error) {
   920	        // tenter le cache avant d'abandonner
   921	        data = await window.SourougnonDB.getCached(cacheKey);
   922	        if (!data) {
   923	          this.ui.showAlert(res.error);
   924	          return;
   925	        }
   926	      } else {
   927	        data = res;
   928	        await window.SourougnonDB.setCached(cacheKey, data);
   929	      }
   930	    }
   931	
   932	    this.archiveData = data;
   933	    this.renderArchiveCalendar(data);
   934	  },
   935	
   936	  renderArchiveCalendar(data) {
   937	    const cal = document.getElementById('archiveCalendar');
   938	    const my  = document.getElementById('archiveMonthYear');
   939	    const tot = document.getElementById('archiveTotaux');
   940	    if (!cal || !my) return;
   941	
   942	    const N = v => Number(v) || 0;
   943	    const money = v => new Intl.NumberFormat('fr-FR',{maximumFractionDigits:0}).format(N(v));
   944	    const iso = d => `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`;
   945	
   946	    const cur = this.currentArchiveMonth;
   947	    my.textContent = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('fr-FR',{month:'long',year:'numeric'}).format(cur);
   948	
   949	    const y = cur.getFullYear(), m = cur.getMonth();
   950	    const offset = (new Date(y,m,1).getDay()+6)%7;
   951	    const nb = new Date(y,m+1,0).getDate();
   952	    const todayStr = iso(new Date());
   953	
   954	    const map = {};
   955	    (data.jours||[]).forEach(j => { map[j.date] = j; });
   956	
   957	    let h = '<div class="arch-dow"><span>L</span><span>M</span><span>M</span><span>J</span><span>V</span><span>S</span><span>D</span></div><div class="arch-grid">';
   958	    for (let i=0;i<offset;i++) h += '<div class="arch-cell arch-cell--empty"></div>';
   959	
   960	    for (let d=1; d<=nb; d++) {
   961	      const ds = `${y}-${String(m+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d).padStart(2,'0')}`;
   962	      const j  = map[ds] || {};
   963	      const total = N(j.total_recouvre) + N(j.total_penalites) + N(j.total_epargnes);
   964	      const st = j.tournee_statut;
   965	
   966	      let cls = 'arch-cell';
   967	      if (st === 'terminee') { cls += ' arch-cell--done'; }
   968	      else if (st === 'en_cours') { cls += ' arch-cell--run'; }
   969	      else if (total > 0) { cls += ' arch-cell--ops'; }
   970	      else if (ds > todayStr) { cls += ' arch-cell--future'; }
   971	      else { cls += ' arch-cell--void'; }
   972	
   973	      if (ds === todayStr) cls += ' arch-cell--today';
   974	      if (ds === this.selectedArchiveDay) cls += ' arch-cell--sel';
   975	
   976	      const clickable = ds <= todayStr;
   977	      const onclickAttr = clickable ? ` data-day="${ds}"` : '';
   978	
   979	      h += `<button type="button" class="${cls}"${onclickAttr}>
   980	        <span class="arch-num">${d}</span>
   981	        ${total>0 ? `<span class="arch-amt">${money(total/1000)}k</span>` : '<span class="arch-amt">&nbsp;</span>'}
   982	      </button>`;
   983	    }
   984	    h += '</div>';
   985	    h += `<div class="arch-legend">
   986	      <span><i class="arch-dot" style="background:var(--green)"></i>Terminée</span>
   987	      <span><i class="arch-dot" style="background:var(--orange)"></i>En cours</span>
   988	      <span><i class="arch-dot" style="background:var(--blue)"></i>Opérations</span>
   989	    </div>`;
   990	    cal.innerHTML = h;
   991	
   992	    // Délégation d'événement unique
   993	    if (!cal.dataset.bound) {
   994	      cal.addEventListener('click', e => {
   995	        const btn = e.target.closest('[data-day]');
   996	        if (btn) {
   997	          this.showArchiveDetail(btn.dataset.day);
   998	        }
   999	      });
  1000	      cal.dataset.bound = '1';
  1001	    }
  1002	
  1003	    if (tot) {
  1004	      const t = data.totaux || {};
  1005	      tot.innerHTML = `<div class="arch-kpis">
  1006	        <div class="arch-kpi"><span>Recouvrements</span><b style="color:var(--green)">${money(t.recouvre)} F</b></div>
  1007	        <div class="arch-kpi"><span>Pénalités</span><b style="color:var(--orange)">${money(t.penalites)} F</b></div>
  1008	        <div class="arch-kpi"><span>Épargnes</span><b style="color:var(--blue)">${money(t.epargnes)} F</b></div>
  1009	        <div class="arch-kpi"><span>Défalques</span><b style="color:var(--red)">-${money(t.defalques_penalites)} F</b></div>
  1010	        <div class="arch-kpi arch-kpi--full"><span>Jours travaillés</span><b>${N(t.jours_travailles)} / ${nb}</b></div>
  1011	      </div>`;
  1012	    }
  1013	  },  showArchiveDetail(ds) {
  1014	    this.selectedArchiveDay = ds;
  1015	    const el = document.getElementById('archiveDetail');
  1016	    if (!el || !this.archiveData) return;
  1017	
  1018	    const N = v => Number(v) || 0;
  1019	    const money = v => new Intl.NumberFormat('fr-FR',{maximumFractionDigits:0}).format(N(v));
  1020	    const j = (this.archiveData.jours||[]).find(x => x.date === ds);
  1021	    const lib = new Date(ds+'T12:00:00').toLocaleDateString('fr-FR',{weekday:'long',day:'numeric',month:'long'});
  1022	
  1023	    if (!j) {
  1024	      el.innerHTML = `<div class="arch-day"><h5>${lib}</h5><div class="arch-empty">Aucune donnée</div></div>`;
  1025	      this.renderArchiveCalendar(this.archiveData);
  1026	      return;
  1027	    }
  1028	
  1029	    const st = j.tournee_statut;
  1030	    const badge = st === 'terminee'
  1031	      ? '<span class="arch-badge" style="background:#d1fae5;color:#065f46">Terminée</span>'
  1032	      : st === 'en_cours'
  1033	      ? '<span class="arch-badge" style="background:#fef3c7;color:#92400e">En cours</span>'
  1034	      : '<span class="arch-badge" style="background:#f1f5f9;color:#64748b">Pas de tournée</span>';
  1035	
  1036	    el.innerHTML = `<div class="arch-day">
  1037	      <h5>${lib}</h5>
  1038	      <div class="arch-row"><span>Tournée</span>${badge}</div>
  1039	      <div class="arch-row"><span>Recouvré</span><b style="color:var(--green)">${money(j.total_recouvre)} F</b></div>
  1040	      <div class="arch-row"><span>Pénalités encaissées</span><b style="color:var(--orange)">${money(j.total_penalites)} F</b></div>
  1041	      <div class="arch-row"><span>Épargnes collectées</span><b style="color:var(--blue)">${money(j.total_epargnes)} F</b></div>
  1042	      <div class="arch-row"><span>Défalques épargne</span><b style="color:var(--red)">-${money(j.total_defalques_penalites)} F</b></div>
  1043	      <div class="arch-row"><span>Paiements</span><b>${N(j.nb_paiements)}</b></div>
  1044	      <div class="arch-row"><span>Absents / Refus / Promesses</span><b>${N(j.nb_absents)} / ${N(j.nb_refus)} / ${N(j.nb_promesses)}</b></div>

>>> public/agent-app/db.js
     1	// db.js — IndexedDB pour l'application agent
     2	const DB_NAME = 'sourougnon-agent-db';
     3	const DB_VERSION = 2;
     4	const STORE_PENDING = 'pending_operations';
     5	const STORE_CACHE = 'cached_responses';
     6	
     7	let dbPromise = null;
     8	
     9	function openDB() {
    10	  if (dbPromise) return dbPromise;
    11	  dbPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    12	    const req = indexedDB.open(DB_NAME, DB_VERSION);
    13	    req.onupgradeneeded = (e) => {
    14	      const db = e.target.result;
    15	      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_PENDING)) {
    16	        db.createObjectStore(STORE_PENDING, { keyPath: 'id', autoIncrement: true });
    17	      }
    18	      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(STORE_CACHE)) {
    19	        db.createObjectStore(STORE_CACHE, { keyPath: 'key' });
    20	      }
    21	    };
    22	    req.onsuccess = (e) => resolve(e.target.result);
    23	    req.onerror = (e) => reject(e.target.error);
    24	  });
    25	  return dbPromise;
    26	}
    27	
    28	async function addPending(operation) {
    29	  const db = await openDB();
    30	  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    31	    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_PENDING, 'readwrite');
    32	    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_PENDING);
    33	    const req = store.add(operation);
    34	    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result);
    35	    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
    36	  });
    37	}
    38	
    39	async function getAllPending() {
    40	  const db = await openDB();
    41	  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    42	    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_PENDING, 'readonly');
    43	    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_PENDING);
    44	    const req = store.getAll();
    45	    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result || []);
    46	    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
    47	  });
    48	}
    49	
    50	async function deletePending(id) {
    51	  const db = await openDB();
    52	  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    53	    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_PENDING, 'readwrite');
    54	    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_PENDING);
    55	    const req = store.delete(id);
    56	    req.onsuccess = () => resolve();
    57	    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
    58	  });
    59	}
    60	
    61	async function clearPending() {
    62	  const db = await openDB();
    63	  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    64	    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_PENDING, 'readwrite');
    65	    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_PENDING);
    66	    const req = store.clear();
    67	    req.onsuccess = () => resolve();
    68	    req.onerror = () => reject(req.error);
    69	  });
    70	}
    71	
    72	// ==================== CACHE GÉNÉRIQUE ====================
    73	async function setCached(key, value) {
    74	  const db = await openDB();
    75	  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    76	    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_CACHE, 'readwrite');
    77	    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_CACHE);
    78	    store.put({ key, value, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
    79	    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
    80	    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
    81	  });
    82	}
    83	
    84	async function getCached(key) {
    85	  const db = await openDB();
    86	  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    87	    const tx = db.transaction(STORE_CACHE, 'readonly');
    88	    const store = tx.objectStore(STORE_CACHE);
    89	    const req = store.get(key);
    90	    req.onsuccess = () => resolve(req.result ? req.result.value : null);
    91	    req.onerror = () => resolve(null);
    92	  });
    93	}
    94	
    95	window.SourougnonDB = { addPending, getAllPending, deletePending, clearPending, setCached, getCached };

>>> public/agent-app/sw.js
     1	const CACHE = 'sourougnon-agent-v202608262045';
     2	const ASSETS = ['./','./login.html','./index.html','./styles.css','./app.js','./db.js','./manifest.json','./assets/logo_sourougnon1.png'];
     3	
     4	self.addEventListener('install', (e) => {
     5	  e.waitUntil((async () => {
     6	    const cache = await caches.open(CACHE);
     7	    await Promise.allSettled(ASSETS.map(u => cache.add(u)));
     8	    self.skipWaiting();
     9	  })());
    10	});
    11	
    12	self.addEventListener('activate', (e) => {
    13	  e.waitUntil((async () => {
    14	    const keys = await caches.keys();
    15	    await Promise.all(keys.filter(k => k !== CACHE).map(k => caches.delete(k)));
    16	    self.clients.claim();
    17	  })());
    18	});
    19	
    20	self.addEventListener('fetch', (e) => {
    21	  const url = new URL(e.request.url);
    22	  if (url.pathname.startsWith('/api/')) return;
    23	
    24	  if (e.request.mode === 'navigate') {
    25	    e.respondWith(
    26	      fetch(e.request)
    27	        .then(r => { const cl = r.clone(); caches.open(CACHE).then(c => c.put(e.request, cl)); return r; })
    28	        .catch(() => caches.match(e.request).then(m => m || caches.match('./index.html')))
    29	    );
    30	    return;
    31	  }
    32	
    33	  e.respondWith(
    34	    caches.match(e.request).then(m => m || fetch(e.request).then(r => {
    35	      const cl = r.clone(); caches.open(CACHE).then(c => c.put(e.request, cl)); return r;
    36	    }))
    37	  );
    38	});

    14	function loadAlertesGroupees(c) {
    15	    apiFetch('/alertes').then(function(a) {
    16	        var groupes = { retard: [], echeance_jour: [], stock_faible: [], autre: [] };
    17	        a.forEach(function(x) { (groupes[x.type] || groupes.autre).push(x); });
    18	        
    19	        var niv = { info: 'badge-info', avertissement: 'badge-warning', critique: 'badge-danger' };
    20	        
    21	        function tableau(titre, lignes) {
    22	            if (!lignes.length) return '';
    23	            return '<div class="panel mb-4"><h3 class="text-lg font-semibold mb-2">' + esc(titre) + ' (' + lignes.length + ')</h3>' +
    24	                '<div class="table-wrapper" style="max-height:400px;overflow:auto"><table><thead><tr>' +
    25	                '<th>Date</th><th>Niveau</th><th>Message</th><th>Etat</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
    26	                lignes.map(function(x) {
    27	                    return '<tr>' +
    28	                        '<td class="text-xs">' + esc((x.date_alerte || '').substring(0, 10)) + '</td>' +
    29	                        '<td><span class="badge ' + (niv[x.niveau] || 'badge-info') + '">' + esc(x.niveau) + '</span></td>' +
    30	                        '<td>' + esc(x.message) + '</td>' +
    31	                        '<td>' + (x.lue ? '<span class="text-green-600 text-xs">Lu</span>' : '<span class="text-amber-600 text-xs font-semibold">Nouveau</span>') + '</td></tr>';
    32	                }).join('') + '</tbody></table></div></div>';
    33	        }
    34

    37	function apiFetch(endpoint, options) {
    38	    options = options || {};
    39	    options.headers = Object.assign({
    40	        'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + authToken,
    41	        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    42	        'Accept': 'application/json'
    43	    }, options.headers || {});
    44	
    45	    if (options.body && typeof options.body === 'object') {
    46	        options.body = JSON.stringify(options.body);
    47	    }
    48	
    49	    return fetch(API_BASE + endpoint, options).then(function (r) {
    50	        if (r.status === 401) {
    51	            localStorage.clear();
    52	            window.location.href = '/dashboard/login.html';
    53	            return Promise.reject(new Error('Session expirée'));
    54	        }
    55	        return r.text().then(function (txt) {
    56	            var data;
    57	            try { data = txt ? JSON.parse(txt) : {}; }
    58	            catch (e) {
    59	                console.error('Réponse non-JSON', r.status, txt.slice(0, 500));
    60	                return Promise.reject(new Error('Erreur serveur ' + r.status));
    61	            }
    62	            if (!r.ok) {
    63	                var msg = data.message || data.error ||
    64	                    (data.errors ? Object.values(data.errors).flat().join('\n') : 'Erreur ' + r.status);
    65	                return Promise.reject(Object.assign(new Error(msg), {status: r.status, data: data}));
    66	            }
    67	            return data;
    68	        });
    69	    });
    70	}

    74	async function apiDownload(endpoint, filename) {
    75	    try {
    76	        const res = await fetch(API_BASE + endpoint, {
    77	            headers: {'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + authToken}
    78	        });
    79	        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Erreur ' + res.status);
    80	        const blob = await res.blob();
    81	        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    82	        const a = document.createElement('a');
    83	        a.href = url;
    84	        a.download = filename;
    85	        document.body.appendChild(a);
    86	        a.click();
    87	        a.remove();
    88	        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    89	    } catch (e) {
    90	        showAlert('Erreur export : ' + e.message);
    91	    }
    92	}

   170	function confirmModal(message, opts) {
   171	    opts = opts || {};
   172	    return new Promise(function(resolve) {
   173	        var el = document.createElement('div');
   174	        el.className = 'fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50';
   175	        el.innerHTML =
   176	            '<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 w-full max-w-sm shadow-2xl">' +
   177	            '<p class="text-sm mb-4"></p>' +
   178	            '<div class="flex gap-2">' +
   179	            '<button data-act="cancel" class="flex-1 px-4 py-2 bg-slate-200 rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold">Annuler</button>' +
   180	            '<button data-act="ok" class="flex-1 px-4 py-2 ' + (opts.danger === false ? 'bg-blue-600' : 'bg-red-600') + ' text-white rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold">Confirmer</button>' +
   181	            '</div></div>';
   182	        el.querySelector('p').textContent = message;
   183	        function close(v) { el.remove(); document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey); resolve(v); }
   184	        function onKey(e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') close(false); }
   185	        el.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
   186	            var a = e.target.getAttribute && e.target.getAttribute('data-act');
   187	            if (a) close(a === 'ok');
   188	            else if (e.target === el) close(false);
   189	        });
   190	        document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
   191	        document.body.appendChild(el);
   192	        el.querySelector('[data-act="ok"]').focus();
   193	    });
   194	}
