     1	(function () {
     2	    'use strict';
     3	
     4	    const SELECT_IDS = {
     5	        departement: 'deb-departement',
     6	        commune: 'deb-commune',
     7	        arrondissement: 'deb-arrondissement',
     8	        quartier: 'deb-village'
     9	    };
    10	
    11	    const API_URL = '/api/localisations';
    12	
    13	    function getSelect(id) {
    14	        return document.getElementById(id);
    15	    }
    16	
    17	    function resetSelect(id, placeholder, disabled) {
    18	        const select = getSelect(id);
    19	        if (!select) return;
    20	        select.innerHTML = '';
    21	        select.appendChild(new Option(placeholder, ''));
    22	        select.disabled = Boolean(disabled);
    23	    }
    24	
    25	    function setLoading(id, placeholder) {
    26	        const select = getSelect(id);
    27	        if (!select) return;
    28	        select.innerHTML = '';
    29	        select.appendChild(new Option(placeholder, ''));
    30	        select.disabled = true;
    31	    }
    32	
    33	    async function chargerOptions(type, parent, selectId, placeholder) {
    34	        const select = getSelect(selectId);
    35	        if (!select) {
    36	            console.warn('[Localisation] Select introuvable : #' + selectId);
    37	            return;
    38	        }
    39	
    40	        setLoading(selectId, 'Chargement...');
    41	
    42	        const params = new URLSearchParams({ type: type });
    43	        if (parent) params.set('parent', parent);
    44	
    45	        try {
    46	            const response = await fetch(API_URL + '?' + params.toString(), {
    47	                headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' },
    48	                cache: 'no-store'
    49	            });
    50	
    51	            const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || '';
    52	            const data = contentType.includes('application/json')
    53	                ? await response.json()
    54	                : null;
    55	
    56	            if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Erreur HTTP ' + response.status);
    57	            if (!Array.isArray(data)) throw new Error('Reponse non JSON');
    58	
    59	            select.innerHTML = '';
    60	            select.appendChild(new Option(placeholder, ''));
    61	            data.forEach(item => select.appendChild(new Option(item.nom, item.nom)));
    62	            select.disabled = false;
    63	            console.log('[Localisation]', type, ':', data.length, 'element(s) charge(s)');
    64	        } catch (error) {
    65	            console.error('[Localisation] Echec chargement', { type, parent, erreur: error });
    66	            select.innerHTML = '';
    67	            select.appendChild(new Option('Erreur de chargement', ''));
    68	            select.disabled = true;
    69	        }
    70	    }
    71	
    72	    function initSelects(root) {
    73	        const scope = root || document;
    74	        const dep = scope.querySelector('#' + SELECT_IDS.departement);
    75	        const com = scope.querySelector('#' + SELECT_IDS.commune);
    76	        const arr = scope.querySelector('#' + SELECT_IDS.arrondissement);
    77	        const quartier = scope.querySelector('#' + SELECT_IDS.quartier);
    78	
    79	        if (!dep) {
    80	            console.warn('[Localisation] #deb-departement introuvable');
    81	            return false;
    82	        }
    83	
    84	        if (dep.dataset.localisationReady === '1') return true;
    85	        dep.dataset.localisationReady = '1';
    86	
    87	        if (com) com.disabled = true;
    88	        if (arr) arr.disabled = true;
    89	        if (quartier) quartier.disabled = true;
    90	
    91	        chargerOptions('departement', '', SELECT_IDS.departement, '-- Departement --');
    92	
    93	        dep.addEventListener('change', function () {
    94	            resetSelect(SELECT_IDS.commune, '-- Commune --', true);
    95	            resetSelect(SELECT_IDS.arrondissement, '-- Arrondissement --', true);
    96	            resetSelect(SELECT_IDS.quartier, '-- Quartier --', true);
    97	            if (this.value) chargerOptions('commune', this.value, SELECT_IDS.commune, '-- Commune --');
    98	        });
    99	
   100	        if (com) com.addEventListener('change', function () {
   101	            resetSelect(SELECT_IDS.arrondissement, '-- Arrondissement --', true);
   102	            resetSelect(SELECT_IDS.quartier, '-- Quartier --', true);
   103	            if (this.value) chargerOptions('arrondissement', this.value, SELECT_IDS.arrondissement, '-- Arrondissement --');
   104	        });
   105	
   106	        if (arr) arr.addEventListener('change', function () {
   107	            resetSelect(SELECT_IDS.quartier, '-- Quartier --', true);
   108	            if (this.value) chargerOptions('quartier', this.value, SELECT_IDS.quartier, '-- Quartier --');
   109	        });
   110	
   111	        return true;
   112	    }
   113	
   114	    function initWhenAvailable() {
   115	        if (initSelects()) return;
   116	        const observer = new MutationObserver(function () {
   117	            if (initSelects()) observer.disconnect();
   118	        });
   119	        observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
   120	    }
   121	
   122	    window.initLocalisationBenin = initSelects;
   123	window.initSelects = initSelects;
   124	
   125	    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
   126	        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initWhenAvailable);
   127	    } else {
   128	        initWhenAvailable();
   129	    }
   130	})();

    72	function drawCaisseMonth() {
    73	    const year = currentCaisseDate.getFullYear();
    74	    const month = currentCaisseDate.getMonth();
    75	    const firstDay = new Date(year, month, 1);
    76	    const lastDay = new Date(year, month + 1, 0);
    77	    const startOffset = (firstDay.getDay() + 6) % 7;
    78	    const daysInMonth = lastDay.getDate();
    79	    const today = new Date();
    80	
    81	    const container = document.getElementById('caisse-calendrier');
    82	    container.innerHTML = '';
    83	
    84	    for (let i = 0; i < startOffset; i++) {
    85	        container.innerHTML += '<div></div>';
    86	    }
    87	
    88	    for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) {
    89	        const dateStr = `${year}-${String(month+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d).padStart(2,'0')}`;
    90	        const isToday = d === today.getDate() && month === today.getMonth() && year === today.getFullYear();
    91	        const dayBtn = document.createElement('button');
    92	        dayBtn.className = `p-2 rounded-lg text-sm border ${isToday ? 'border-blue-500' : 'border-slate-200'} hover:bg-slate-50`;
    93	        dayBtn.innerHTML = `<div class="font-medium">${d}</div><div id="solde-${dateStr}" class="text-xs mt-1">...</div><div id="pastille-${dateStr}" class="mt-1"><span class="w-2 h-2 inline-block rounded-full bg-gray-300"></span></div>`;
    94	        dayBtn.onclick = () => selectCaisseDay(dateStr);
    95	        container.appendChild(dayBtn);
    96	    }
    97	
    98	    loadCaissePeriode(year, month);
    99	}

   101	async function loadCaissePeriode(year, month) {
   102	    const debut = `${year}-${String(month+1).padStart(2,'0')}-01`;
   103	    const fin = new Date(year, month+1, 0).toISOString().split('T')[0];
   104	
   105	    try {
   106	        const res = await apiFetch(`/caisse/periode?debut=${debut}&fin=${fin}`);
   107	        if (!Array.isArray(res)) return;
   108	
   109	        res.forEach(item => {
   110	            const soldeEl = document.getElementById(`solde-${item.jour}`);
   111	            const pastilleEl = document.getElementById(`pastille-${item.jour}`);
   112	
   113	            const encaissements = Number(item.encaissements || 0);
   114	            const decaissements = Number(item.decaissements || 0);
   115	            const epargnes = Number(item.epargnes || 0);
   116	            const penalites = Number(item.penalites || 0);
   117	            const ecart = Number(item.ecart || 0);
   118	            const nbMouvements = Number(item.nb_mouvements || 0);
   119	            const solde = encaissements + epargnes + penalites - decaissements;
   120	
   121	            if (soldeEl) {
   122	                soldeEl.textContent = nbMouvements > 0
   123	                    ? new Intl.NumberFormat('fr-FR', { maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(solde) + ' F'
   124	                    : '';
   125	            }
   126	
   127	            if (!pastilleEl) return;
   128	
   129	            let couleur = 'bg-gray-300';
   130	            let titre = 'Aucun mouvement';
   131	
   132	            if (item.non_cloture) {
   133	                couleur = 'bg-red-500';
   134	                titre = 'Caisse non clôturée';
   135	            } else if (Math.abs(ecart) > 0.009) {
   136	                couleur = 'bg-orange-500';
   137	                titre = 'Écart de caisse : ' + ecart;
   138	            } else if (nbMouvements > 0) {
   139	                couleur = 'bg-green-500';
   140	                titre = nbMouvements + ' mouvement(s)';
   141	            }
   142	
   143	            pastilleEl.innerHTML = `<span title="${titre}" class="w-2 h-2 inline-block rounded-full ${couleur}"></span>`;
   144	        });
   145	    } catch (e) {
   146	        console.error('loadCaissePeriode', e);
   147	    }
   148	}

   111	            c.appendChild(sec);
   112	            c.appendChild(cons);
   113	            loadComptabiliteSecondaire();
   114	            loadComptabiliteConsolidee();
   115	
   116	            // Pagination
   117	            var btnPrec = document.getElementById('journal-page-precedente');
   118	            var btnSuiv = document.getElementById('journal-page-suivante');
   119	            if (btnPrec) btnPrec.onclick = function() { if (journalPage > 1) { journalPage--; chargerEtAfficher(); } };
   120	            if (btnSuiv) btnSuiv.onclick = function() { var tp = Number(journalData.total_pages || 1); if (journalPage < tp) { journalPage++; chargerEtAfficher(); } };
   121	        }).catch(function(err) {
   122	            console.error(err);
   123	            c.innerHTML = '<div class="panel text-center py-12"><p class="text-muted">Erreur de chargement de la comptabilité.</p></div>';
   124	        });
   125	    }
   126	
   127	    chargerEtAfficher();
   128	}

    53	function getUrlFiltre(type, endpoint) {

    74	function groupByDate(list, dateKey, montantKey) {
    75	    const map = {};
    76	    list.forEach(item => {
    77	        const date = item[dateKey] ? new Date(item[dateKey]).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short' }) : 'Inconnu';
    78	        map[date] = (map[date] || 0) + parseFloat(item[montantKey] || 0);
    79	    });
    80	    return map;
    81	}

    23	        });

    34	            .then(r => r.json())
    35	            .then(data => {
    36	                comSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Commune --</option>' +
    37	                    data.map(c => '<option value="' + c.nom + '">' + c.nom + '</option>').join('');
    38	                console.log('[LOC] ' + data.length + ' communes charges');
    39	            });
    40	    };
    41	    
    42	    // Quand on change de commune
    43	    if (comSelect) comSelect.onchange = function() {
    44	        arrSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Arrondissement --</option>';
    45	        vilSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Village/Quartier --</option>';
    46	        
    47	        if (!this.value) return;
    48	        
    49	        fetch('/api/localisations?type=arrondissement&parent=' + encodeURIComponent(this.value))

    53	                    data.map(a => '<option value="' + a.nom + '">' + a.nom + '</option>').join('');
    54	                console.log('[LOC] ' + data.length + ' arrondissements charges');
    55	            });
    56	    };
    57	    
    58	    // Quand on change d'arrondissement
    59	    if (arrSelect) arrSelect.onchange = function() {
    60	        vilSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Village/Quartier --</option>';
    61	        
    62	        if (!this.value) return;
    63	        
    64	        fetch('/api/localisations?type=quartier&parent=' + encodeURIComponent(this.value))
    65	            .then(r => r.json())
    66	            .then(data => {

    68	                    data.map(q => '<option value="' + q.nom + '">' + q.nom + '</option>').join('');
    69	                console.log('[LOC] ' + data.length + ' quartiers charges');
    70	            });
    71	    };
    72	}

    74	function getLocalisationComplete() {
    75	    var parts = [];
    76	    var ids = ['deb-departement', 'deb-commune', 'deb-arrondissement', 'deb-village'];
    77	    ids.forEach(function(id) {
    78	        var el = document.getElementById(id);
    79	        if (el && el.value) parts.push(el.value);
    80	    });
    81	    return parts.join(' > ') || '';
    82	}

    41	            actions += '</div>';
    42

    45	                '<td class="text-xs">'+x.email+'</td>'+

    57	function openPermissionsModal(uuid, nom, permissions) {
    58	    var perms = permissions || {};
    59	    var html = '<div class="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/50" id="perm-modal-overlay" onclick="if(event.target===this)closePermissionsModal()">';
    60	    html += '<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 w-full max-w-md shadow-2xl fade-in max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">';
    61	    html += '<h3 class="text-lg font-bold mb-4">Permissions de ' + nom + '</h3>';
    62	    html += '<div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">';
    63	    allPages.forEach(function(p) {
    64	        var checked = perms[p.id] !== undefined ? perms[p.id] : true;
    65	        html += '<label class="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 bg-slate-50 rounded-lg cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-100 text-sm"><input type="checkbox" '+(checked?'checked':'')+' onchange="togglePermission(\''+uuid+'\',\''+p.id+'\',this.checked)" class="w-4 h-4 text-accent">'+p.label+'</label>';
    66	    });
    67	    html += '</div>';
    68	    html += '<div class="flex gap-3 pt-4"><button onclick="closePermissionsModal()" class="flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 bg-accent text-white rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold">Fermer</button></div>';
    69	    html += '</div></div>';
    70	    
    71	    var existing = document.getElementById('perm-modal-overlay');
    72	    if(existing) existing.remove();
    73	    document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
    74	}

    18	                        p.map(function(x){
    19	                            var benefice = (x.prix_vente||0) - (x.prix_achat||0);
    20	                            var marge = (x.prix_achat > 0) ? ((benefice / x.prix_achat) * 100).toFixed(1) + '%' : '--';
    21	                            return '<tr>'+
    22	                                '<td class="font-medium">'+x.nom+'</td>'+
    23	                                '<td><input type="number" value="'+(x.prix_achat||0)+'" onchange="updateProduitPrix(\''+x.uuid+'\',\'prix_achat\',this.value)" class="w-24 px-2 py-1 border rounded text-xs text-right"></td>'+
    24	                                '<td><input type="number" value="'+(x.prix_vente||0)+'" onchange="updateProduitPrix(\''+x.uuid+'\',\'prix_vente\',this.value)" class="w-24 px-2 py-1 border rounded text-xs text-right"></td>'+
    25	                                '<td class="font-semibold text-green-600">'+f(benefice)+'</td>'+
    26	                                '<td class="text-xs">'+marge+'</td>'+
    27	                                '<td><span class="badge '+(x.stock<=x.seuil_alerte?'badge-danger':'badge-success')+'">'+(x.stock||0)+'</span></td>'+
    28	                                '<td><div class="flex gap-1">'+
    29	                                    '<button onclick="categoriserProduit(\''+x.uuid+'\',\''+x.nom+'\')" class="text-blue-600 text-xs">Cat.</button>'+
    30	                                    '<button onclick="supprimerProduit(\''+x.uuid+'\',\''+x.nom+'\')" class="text-red-600 text-xs">Suppr.</button>'+
    31	                                '</div></td>'+
    32	                            '</tr>';
    33	                        }).join('')+
    34	                    '</tbody></table>'+
    35	                '</div>'+
    36	            '</div>'+
    37	            '<div class="panel max-w-md">'+
    38	                '<h3>Resume des benefices</h3>'+
    39	                '<div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 mt-4">'+
    40	                    '<div class="text-center"><span class="text-xs text-muted">Valeur achat</span><div class="font-bold">'+f(p.reduce((s,x)=>s+(x.prix_achat||0)*(x.stock||0),0))+'</div></div>'+
    41	                    '<div class="text-center"><span class="text-xs text-muted">Valeur vente</span><div class="font-bold text-green-600">'+f(p.reduce((s,x)=>s+(x.prix_vente||0)*(x.stock||0),0))+'</div></div>'+
    42	                    '<div class="text-center"><span class="text-xs text-muted">Benefice potentiel</span><div class="font-bold text-accent">'+f(p.reduce((s,x)=>s+((x.prix_vente||0)-(x.prix_achat||0))*(x.stock||0),0))+'</div></div>'+
    43	                '</div>'+
    44	            '</div>'+
    45	        '</div>';
    46	    });
    47	}

    30	function switchRapport(type) {
    31	    rapportType = type;
    32	    document.querySelectorAll('#rapport-filtres .chip').forEach(ch => ch.classList.remove('chip--active'));

    38	function chargerRapport() {
    39	    const debut = document.getElementById('rapport-debut').value;
    40	    const fin = document.getElementById('rapport-fin').value;
    41	    let params = '';
    42	    if (debut) params += '&date_debut=' + debut;
    43	    if (fin) params += '&date_fin=' + fin;
    44	
    45	    let endpoint = '/rapports/' + rapportType;
    46	    if (rapportType === 'ventes') endpoint += '?' + params.slice(1);
    47	    else if (rapportType === 'recouvrements') endpoint += '?' + params.slice(1);
    48	    else endpoint = '/rapports/resume';
    49	
    50	    apiFetch(endpoint).then(r => {
    51	        if (rapportType === 'resume') {
    52	            afficherResume(r);
    53	        } else {
    54	            afficherTableauRapport(r);
    55	        }
    56	    }).catch(e => showAlert('Erreur : ' + e.message));
    57	}
    58	
    59	function afficherTableauRapport(data) {
    60	    const conteneur = document.getElementById('rapport-contenu');
    61	    if (!Array.isArray(data) || data.length === 0) {
    62	        conteneur.innerHTML = '<p class="text-muted text-center py-4">Aucune donnée</p>';
    63	        return;
    64	    }
    65	    const f = v => new Intl.NumberFormat('fr-FR',{style:'currency',currency:'XOF',maximumFractionDigits:0}).format(v||0);
    66	
    67	    let html = '<div class="table-wrapper"><table><thead><tr>';
    68	    if (rapportType === 'ventes') {
    69	        html += '<th>Date</th><th>Débiteur</th><th>Agent</th><th>Type</th><th>Montant</th><th>Payé</th><th>Restant</th><th>Statut</th>';
    70	    } else if (rapportType === 'recouvrements') {
    71	        html += '<th>Date</th><th>Débiteur</th><th>Agent</th><th>Montant</th><th>Mode</th><th>Statut</th>';
    72	    }
    73	    html += '</tr></thead><tbody>';
    74	
    75	    data.forEach(v => {
    76	        if (rapportType === 'ventes') {
    77	            html += `<tr><td>${new Date(v.date_debut).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR')}</td><td>${v.debiteur?.nom || '--'} ${v.debiteur?.prenom || ''}</td><td>${v.agent?.nom || '--'}</td><td>${v.type_vente}</td><td>${f(v.montant_total)}</td><td>${f(v.total_paye)}</td><td>${f(v.reste_a_payer)}</td><td>${v.statut}</td></tr>`;
    78	        } else if (rapportType === 'recouvrements') {
    79	            html += `<tr><td>${new Date(v.date_recouvrement).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR')}</td><td>${v.vente?.debiteur?.nom || '--'} ${v.vente?.debiteur?.prenom || ''}</td><td>${v.agent?.nom || '--'}</td><td>${f(v.montant)}</td><td>${v.mode_paiement}</td><td>${v.statut}</td></tr>`;
    80	        }
    81	    });
    82	
    83	    html += '</tbody></table></div>';
    84	    conteneur.innerHTML = html;
    85	}

   105	function exporterCSV() {
   106	    const token = localStorage.getItem('sourougnon_token') || '';
   107	    const debut = document.getElementById('rapport-debut').value;
   108	    const fin = document.getElementById('rapport-fin').value;
   109	    let url = `/api/rapports/${rapportType}?format=csv`;
   110	    if (debut) url += '&date_debut=' + debut;
   111	    if (fin) url += '&date_fin=' + fin;
   112	    url += '&token=' + encodeURIComponent(token);
   113	    window.open(url, '_blank');
   114	}

   116	function exporterPDF() {
   117	    const token = localStorage.getItem('sourougnon_token') || '';
   118	    const debut = document.getElementById('rapport-debut').value;
   119	    const fin = document.getElementById('rapport-fin').value;
   120	    let url = (rapportType === 'resume') ? '/api/rapports/resume-pdf' : `/api/rapports/${rapportType}?format=pdf`;
   121	    if (debut) url += (url.includes('?')?'&':'?') + 'date_debut=' + debut;
   122	    if (fin) url += (url.includes('?')?'&':'?') + 'date_fin=' + fin;
   123	    url += (url.includes('?')?'&':'?') + 'token=' + encodeURIComponent(token);
   124	    window.open(url, '_blank');
   125	}

     1	// === MOTEUR DE RECHERCHE GLOBALE ===
     2	var rechercheTimeout;

     4	function rechercheGlobale(query) {
     5	    clearTimeout(rechercheTimeout);
     6	    var resultsDiv = document.getElementById('search-results');
     7	    if (!resultsDiv) return;
     8	    
     9	    if (!query || query.length < 2) {
    10	        resultsDiv.classList.add('hidden');
    11	        return;
    12	    }
    13	    
    14	    rechercheTimeout = setTimeout(function() {
    15	        apiFetch('/recherche?q=' + encodeURIComponent(query)).then(function(data) {
    16	            if (!data || (!data.debiteurs.length && !data.ventes.length && !data.agents.length && !data.produits.length)) {
    17	                resultsDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="p-4 text-sm text-muted text-center">Aucun resultat pour "' + query + '"</div>';
    18	                resultsDiv.classList.remove('hidden');
    19	                return;
    20	            }
    21	            
    22	            var html = '';
    23	            
    24	            if (data.debiteurs && data.debiteurs.length > 0) {
    25	                html += '<div class="p-2 text-xs font-semibold text-muted uppercase">Debiteurs (' + data.debiteurs.length + ')</div>';
    26	                data.debiteurs.forEach(function(d) {
    27	                    html += '<div class="px-4 py-2 hover:bg-slate-50 cursor-pointer text-sm" onclick="loadPage(\'debiteurs\');document.getElementById(\'search-results\').classList.add(\'hidden\')">' +
    28	                        '<span class="font-medium">' + d.nom + ' ' + (d.prenom||'') + '</span> ' +
    29	                        '<span class="text-muted text-xs">' + (d.quartier||'') + ' | ' + (d.telephone||'') + '</span></div>';
    30	                });
    31	            }
    32	            
    33	            if (data.agents && data.agents.length > 0) {
    34	                html += '<div class="p-2 text-xs font-semibold text-muted uppercase border-t">Agents (' + data.agents.length + ')</div>';
    35	                data.agents.forEach(function(a) {
    36	                    html += '<div class="px-4 py-2 hover:bg-slate-50 cursor-pointer text-sm" onclick="loadPage(\'agents\');document.getElementById(\'search-results\').classList.add(\'hidden\')">' +
    37	                        '<span class="font-medium">' + a.nom + ' ' + (a.prenom||'') + '</span> ' +
    38	                        '<span class="text-muted text-xs">' + a.email + ' | ' + a.role + '</span></div>';
    39	                });
    40	            }
    41	            
    42	            if (data.ventes && data.ventes.length > 0) {
    43	                html += '<div class="p-2 text-xs font-semibold text-muted uppercase border-t">Ventes (' + data.ventes.length + ')</div>';
    44	                data.ventes.forEach(function(v) {
    45	                    html += '<div class="px-4 py-2 hover:bg-slate-50 cursor-pointer text-sm" onclick="loadPage(\'ventes\');document.getElementById(\'search-results\').classList.add(\'hidden\')">' +
    46	                        '<span class="font-medium">' + (v.debiteur_nom||'Client') + '</span> ' +
    47	                        '<span class="text-muted text-xs">' + v.type_vente + ' | ' + new Intl.NumberFormat('fr-FR',{style:'currency',currency:'XOF'}).format(v.montant_total||0) + '</span></div>';
    48	                });
    49	            }
    50	            
    51	            if (data.produits && data.produits.length > 0) {
    52	                html += '<div class="p-2 text-xs font-semibold text-muted uppercase border-t">Produits (' + data.produits.length + ')</div>';
    53	                data.produits.forEach(function(p) {
    54	                    html += '<div class="px-4 py-2 hover:bg-slate-50 cursor-pointer text-sm" onclick="loadPage(\'produits\');document.getElementById(\'search-results\').classList.add(\'hidden\')">' +
    55	                        '<span class="font-medium">' + p.nom + '</span> ' +
    56	                        '<span class="text-muted text-xs">Stock: ' + (p.stock||0) + ' | Prix: ' + new Intl.NumberFormat('fr-FR',{style:'currency',currency:'XOF'}).format(p.prix_vente||0) + '</span></div>';
    57	                });
    58	            }
    59	            
    60	            resultsDiv.innerHTML = html;
    61	            resultsDiv.classList.remove('hidden');
    62	        }).catch(function(e) {
    63	            console.error('Erreur recherche:', e);
    64	        });
    65	    }, 300);
    66	}

    38	function renderMouvementsStock(m) {
    39	    function f(v) {
    40	        return new Intl.NumberFormat('fr-FR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'XOF', maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(v);
    41	    }
    42	    var c = document.getElementById('mouvements-stock-content');
    43	    if (!c) return;
    44	    var tb = { entree: 'badge-success', vente: 'badge-danger', sortie: 'badge-danger', perte: 'badge-danger', retour: 'badge-warning', inventaire: 'badge-info' };
    45	    var actionBadge = { creation: 'badge-success', modification: 'badge-warning', suppression: 'badge-danger', inventaire: 'badge-info' };
    46	    
    47	    c.innerHTML = '<div class="table-wrapper"><table><thead><tr><th>Date</th><th>Type</th><th>Action</th><th>Produit</th><th>Qte</th><th>Prix Unit.</th><th>Fournisseur</th><th>Actions</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
    48	    (m.length > 0 ? m.map(function(x) {
    49	        return '<tr>' +
    50	        '<td class="text-xs">' + new Date(x.created_at).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR') + ' ' + new Date(x.created_at).toLocaleTimeString('fr-FR', {hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}) + '</td>' +
    51	        '<td><span class="badge ' + (tb[x.type] || 'badge-info') + '">' + x.type + '</span></td>' +
    52	        '<td><span class="badge ' + (actionBadge[x.action] || 'badge-success') + '">' + (x.action || 'creation') + '</span></td>' +
    53	        '<td class="font-medium">' + (x.produit ? x.produit.nom : '-') + '</td>' +
    54	        '<td>' + x.quantite + '</td>' +
    55	        '<td>' + f(x.prix_unitaire) + '</td>' +
    56	        '<td>' + (x.fournisseur || '-') + '</td>' +
    57	        '<td><div class="flex gap-1">' +
    58	        '<button onclick="openModifierMouvementModal(' + x.id + ',' + x.quantite + ',' + x.prix_unitaire + ',\'' + (x.fournisseur || '').replace(/'/g, "\\'") + '\')" class="text-amber-600 text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-1 bg-amber-50 rounded hover:bg-amber-100">Mod.</button>' +
    59	        '<button onclick="openSupprimerMouvementModal(' + x.id + ')" class="text-red-600 text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-1 bg-red-50 rounded hover:bg-red-100">Suppr.</button>' +
    60	        '</div></td></tr>';
    61	    }).join('') : '<tr><td colspan="8" class="text-center text-muted py-4">Aucun mouvement trouve</td></tr>') +
    62	    '</tbody></table></div>';
    63	}

>>> public/dashboard/js/tournees-functions.js
     1	// === PAGE TOURNÉES ===
     2	function loadTournees(c) {
     3	    apiFetch('/tournees').then(function(list) {
     4	        if (!Array.isArray(list)) list = [];
     5	        const rows = list.map(function(t) {
     6	            const agent = t.agent ? (t.agent.nom + ' ' + t.agent.prenom) : '-';
     7	            const debut = t.heure_demarrage ? new Date(t.heure_demarrage).toLocaleTimeString('fr-FR') : '-';
     8	            const fin = t.heure_fin ? new Date(t.heure_fin).toLocaleTimeString('fr-FR') : '-';
     9	            let duree = '-';
    10	            if (t.heure_demarrage && t.heure_fin) {
    11	                const ms = new Date(t.heure_fin) - new Date(t.heure_demarrage);
    12	                const mins = Math.round(ms / 60000);
    13	                duree = Math.floor(mins / 60) + 'h ' + (mins % 60) + 'm';
    14	            }
    15	            const statut = t.statut === 'en_cours' ? '<span class="badge badge-info">En cours</span>' : '<span class="badge badge-success">Terminée</span>';
    16	            return `<tr>
    17	                <td>${agent}</td>
    18	                <td>${t.date_tournee}</td>
    19	                <td>${debut}</td>
    20	                <td>${fin}</td>
    21	                <td>${duree}</td>
    22	                <td>${statut}</td>
    23	            </tr>`;
    24	        }).join('');
    25	        c.innerHTML = `<div class="fade-in space-y-6">
    26	            <h3 class="text-xl font-bold">Tournées des agents</h3>
    27	            <div class="panel">
    28	                <div class="table-wrapper">
    29	                    <table>
    30	                        <thead><tr><th>Agent</th><th>Date</th><th>Démarrage</th><th>Fin</th><th>Durée</th><th>Statut</th></tr></thead>
    31	                        <tbody>${rows || '<tr><td colspan="6" class="text-center">Aucune tournée</td></tr>'}</tbody>
    32	                    </table>
    33	                </div>
    34	            </div>
    35	        </div>`;
    36	    }).catch(function() {
    37	        c.innerHTML = '<div class="panel text-center py-12"><p class="text-muted">Erreur chargement.</p></div>';
    38	    });
    39	}

    54	    });

    59	var vcrPanier = [];
    60	
    61	function ajouterAuPanier() {
    62	    var select = document.getElementById('vcr-produit');
    63	    if (!select || !select.value) return;
    64	    
    65	    var opt = select.options[select.selectedIndex];
    66	    var produitId = select.value;
    67	    var nom = opt.text.split(' - ')[0] || 'Produit';
    68	    var prix = parseFloat(opt.getAttribute('data-prix')) || 0;
    69	    var quantiteInput = document.getElementById('vcr-quantite');
    70	    var quantite = quantiteInput ? parseInt(quantiteInput.value) || 1 : 1;
    71	    
    72	    if (quantite < 1) quantite = 1;
    73	    
    74	    vcrPanier.push({produit_id: produitId, nom: nom, prix: prix, quantite: quantite});
    75	    renderPanierUI();
    76	}
    77	
    78	function retirerDuPanier(index) {
    79	    vcrPanier.splice(index, 1);
    80	    renderPanierUI();
    81	}
    82	
    83	function renderPanierUI() {
    84	    var itemsEl = document.getElementById('vcr-panier-items');
    85	    var countEl = document.getElementById('vcr-panier-count');
    86	    if (countEl) countEl.textContent = vcrPanier.length;
    87	    
    88	    if (!itemsEl) return;
    89	    
    90	    if (vcrPanier.length === 0) {
    91	        itemsEl.innerHTML = '<p class="text-xs text-slate-400 italic">Aucun produit dans le panier</p>';
    92	        var mtInput = document.getElementById('vcr-montant');
    93	        var pvInput = document.getElementById('vcr-prix-vente');
    94	        if (mtInput) mtInput.value = '';
    95	        if (pvInput) pvInput.value = '';
    96	        if (typeof calculerJournalier === 'function') calculerJournalier();
    97	        return;
    98	    }
    99	    
   100	    var total = vcrPanier.reduce(function(sum, item) { return sum + (item.prix * (item.quantite || 1)); }, 0);
   101	    
   102	    itemsEl.innerHTML = vcrPanier.map(function(item, idx) {
   103	        return '<div class="flex justify-between items-center p-2 bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg text-xs shadow-sm">' +
   104	               '<span class="font-medium text-slate-800">' + item.nom + ' × ' + (item.quantite || 1) + '</span>' +
   105	               '<div class="flex items-center gap-2">' +
   106	               '<span class="font-bold">' + new Intl.NumberFormat('fr-FR', {style: 'currency', currency: 'XOF'}).format(item.prix * (item.quantite || 1)) + '</span>' +
   107	               '<button type="button" onclick="retirerDuPanier(' + idx + ')" class="px-2 py-1 bg-rose-50 hover:bg-rose-100 text-rose-600 rounded font-semibold text-xs">✕ Retirer</button>' +
   108	               '</div></div>';
   109	    }).join('');
   110	    
   111	    var mtInput = document.getElementById('vcr-montant');
   112	    var pvInput = document.getElementById('vcr-prix-vente');
   113	    if (mtInput) mtInput.value = total;
   114	    if (pvInput) pvInput.value = total;
   115	    if (typeof calculerJournalier === 'function') calculerJournalier();
   116	}

   118	function genererContrat(uuid) {
   119	    // 1. Ouvrir la fenêtre IMMÉDIATEMENT pendant le geste utilisateur
   120	    var w = window.open('', '_blank');

style="width:100%;margin:0"><tr><th>Article</th><th>Qte</th><th>P.U.</th><th>Total</th></tr>'+c.produits.map(function(p){return '<tr><td>'+p.nom+'</td><td>'+p.quantite+'</td><td>'+f(p.prix_unitaire)+'</td><td>'+f(p.total)+'</td></tr>';}).join('')+'</table>';}return c.produit||'Non specifie';})() + '</td></tr><tr><th>Prix de    148	function onDebiteurChangeCredit() {
   149	    var debiteurId = document.getElementById('vcr-debiteur').value;
   150	    var scoreBadge = document.getElementById('vcr-score-badge');
   151	    var motifField = document.getElementById('vcr-motif');
   152	    
   153	    if (!debiteurId) {
   154	        if (scoreBadge) scoreBadge.innerHTML = '';
   155	        if (motifField) motifField.required = false;
   156	        return;
   157	    }
   158	    
   159	    apiFetch('/debiteurs/' + debiteurId + '/score').then(function(r) {
   160	        if (scoreBadge && r.score !== undefined) {
   161	            var color = r.score >= 80 ? '#00c853' : r.score >= 60 ? '#0066ff' : r.score >= 40 ? '#f59e0b' : '#ef4444';
   162	            scoreBadge.innerHTML = '<span class="badge" style="background:'+color+'20;color:'+color+';font-weight:bold;font-size:12px;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:6px;display:inline-block;">Score: ' + r.score + '% (' + (r.label || '') + ')</span>';
   163	            
   164	            // Si le score est < 40, le motif devient obligatoire
   165	            if (motifField) {
   166	                if (r.score < 40) {
   167	                    motifField.required = true;
   168	                    motifField.placeholder = 'MOTIF OBLIGATOIRE - Score insuffisant (' + r.score + '%)';
   169	                    motifField.classList.add('border-red-500');
   170	                } else {
   171	                    motifField.required = false;
   172	                    motifField.placeholder = 'Ex: Client fidèle, situation exceptionnelle...';
   173	                    motifField.classList.remove('border-red-500');
   174	                }
   175	            }
   176	        }
   177	    }).catch(function() {
   178	        if (scoreBadge) scoreBadge.innerHTML = '';
   179	    });
   180	}

     1	function loadVentes(c){
     2	    apiFetch('/ventes').then(function(v){
     3	        function f(x){return new Intl.NumberFormat('fr-FR',{style:'currency',currency:'XOF',maximumFractionDigits:0}).format(x);}
     4	        c.innerHTML='<div class="fade-in space-y-6"><div class="flex items-center justify-between"><h3 class="text-xl font-bold">Ventes</h3></div><div class="panel"><div class="table-wrapper"><table><thead><tr><th>N</th><th>Debiteur</th><th>Type</th><th>Montant</th><th>Journalier</th><th>Restant</th><th>Statut</th><th>Actions</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+
     5	        (v.length>0 ? v.map(function(x){
     6	            var actions = '--';
     7	            if (x.statut === "en_cours") {
     8	                if ((x.total_paye || 0) > 0) {
     9	                    actions = '<button onclick="demanderRemboursement(\''+x.uuid+'\')" class="text-orange-600 text-xs font-semibold">Rembourser</button>';
    10	                } else {
    11	                    actions = '<button onclick="annulerVente(\''+x.uuid+'\')" class="text-red-600 text-xs">Annuler</button>';
    12	                }
    13	            }
    14	            return '<tr><td class="font-mono text-xs">'+x.uuid.substring(0,8)+'</td>'+
    15	                '<td class="font-medium">'+(x.debiteur ? x.debiteur.nom+' '+(x.debiteur.prenom||'') : '--')+'</td>'+
    16	                '<td><span class="badge '+(x.type_vente==="comptant"?"badge-info":"badge-warning")+'">'+(x.type_vente==="comptant"?"Comptant":"Credit")+'</span></td>'+
    17	                '<td class="font-semibold">'+f(x.montant_total)+'</td>'+
    18	                '<td>'+f(x.montant_journalier)+'</td>'+
    19	                '<td>'+f(x.montant_total-(x.total_paye||0))+'</td>'+
    20	                '<td><span class="badge '+(x.statut==="en_cours"?"badge-success":x.statut==="termine"?"badge-info":"badge-danger")+'">'+x.statut+'</span></td>'+
    21	                '<td>'+actions+'</td></tr>';
    22	        }).join('') : '<tr><td colspan="8" class="text-center text-muted py-4">Aucune vente</td></tr>')+
    23	        '</tbody></table></div></div></div>';
    24	    });
    25	}

    45	function submitPenalite(e) {
    46	    e.preventDefault();
    47	    var data = {
    48	        penalite_par_jour: parseFloat(document.getElementById('pen-nouveau-montant').value) || 0,
    49	        penalite_active: (parseFloat(document.getElementById('pen-nouveau-montant').value) > 0),

    39	        // Récupérer le rôle depuis l'URL
    40	        const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    41	        const role = urlParams.get('role') || 'gerante';
    42	
    43	        async function handleLogin(e) {
    44	            e.preventDefault();
    45	            const email = document.getElementById('email').value;
    46	            const password = document.getElementById('password').value;
    47	            const errorEl = document.getElementById('error-msg');
    48	            errorEl.classList.add('hidden');
    49	            try {
    50	                const res = await fetch('/api/auth/login', {
    51	                    method: 'POST',
    52	                    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    53	                    body: JSON.stringify({ email, password, role: role })
    54	                });
    55	                const data = await res.json();
    56	                if (data.success) {
    57	                    // Vérifier que le rôle correspond
    58	                    if (data.user.role !== role) {
    59	                        errorEl.textContent = 'Ce compte n\'a pas le rôle ' + (role === 'chef_agence' ? 'Chef d\'agence' : 'Gérante');
    60	                        errorEl.classList.remove('hidden');
    61	                        return;
    62	                    }
    63	                    localStorage.setItem('sourougnon_token', data.token);
    64	                    localStorage.setItem('sourougnon_user', JSON.stringify(data.user));
    65	                    // Rediriger selon le rôle
    66	                    if (data.user.role === 'gerante') {
    67	                        window.location.href = '/dashboard/';
    68	                    } else if (data.user.role === 'chef_agence') {
    69	                        window.location.href = '/dashboard/chef/';
    70	                    }
    71	                } else {
    72	                    errorEl.textContent = data.error || 'Erreur de connexion';
    73	                    errorEl.classList.remove('hidden');
    74	                }
    75	            } catch (err) {
    76	                errorEl.textContent = 'Erreur réseau. Veuillez réessayer.';
    77	                errorEl.classList.remove('hidden');
    78	            }
    79	        }
    80	    </script>
    81	</body>
    82	</html>

    37	function apiFetch(endpoint, options) {
    38	    options = options || {}; options.headers = options.headers || {};
    39	    options.headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer ' + authToken;
    40	    options.headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json';
    41	    if (options.body && typeof options.body === 'object') { options.body = JSON.stringify(options.body); }
    42	    return fetch(API_BASE + endpoint, options).then(function (r) {
    43	        if (r.status === 401) { localStorage.clear(); window.location.href = '/dashboard/login.html'; }
    44	        return r.json();
    45	    });
    46	}

    50	async function apiDownload(endpoint, filename) {
    51	    try {
    52	        const res = await fetch(API_BASE + endpoint, {
    53	            headers: {'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + authToken}
    54	        });
    55	        if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Erreur ' + res.status);
    56	        const blob = await res.blob();
    57	        const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    58	        const a = document.createElement('a');
    59	        a.href = url;
    60	        a.download = filename;
    61	        document.body.appendChild(a);
    62	        a.click();
    63	        a.remove();
    64	        URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    65	    } catch (e) {
    66	        showAlert('Erreur export : ' + e.message);
    67	    }
    68	}

    74	        document.body.appendChild(overlay);
    75	        overlay.querySelector('p').textContent = message;
    76	        overlay.querySelector('button').onclick = function(){ overlay.remove(); resolve(); };
    77	    });
    78	}

     1	(function () {
     2	    'use strict';
     3	
     4	    const SELECT_IDS = {
     5	        departement: 'deb-departement',
     6	        commune: 'deb-commune',
     7	        arrondissement: 'deb-arrondissement',
     8	        quartier: 'deb-village'
     9	    };
    10	
    11	    const API_URL = '/api/localisations';
    12	
    13	    function getSelect(id) {
    14	        return document.getElementById(id);
    15	    }
    16	
    17	    function resetSelect(id, placeholder, disabled) {
    18	        const select = getSelect(id);
    19	        if (!select) return;
    20	        select.innerHTML = '';
    21	        select.appendChild(new Option(placeholder, ''));
    22	        select.disabled = Boolean(disabled);
    23	    }
    24	
    25	    function setLoading(id, placeholder) {
    26	        const select = getSelect(id);
    27	        if (!select) return;
    28	        select.innerHTML = '';
    29	        select.appendChild(new Option(placeholder, ''));
    30	        select.disabled = true;
    31	    }
    32	
    33	    async function chargerOptions(type, parent, selectId, placeholder) {
    34	        const select = getSelect(selectId);
    35	        if (!select) {
    36	            console.warn('[Localisation] Select introuvable : #' + selectId);
    37	            return;
    38	        }
    39	
    40	        setLoading(selectId, 'Chargement...');
    41	
    42	        const params = new URLSearchParams({ type: type });
    43	        if (parent) params.set('parent', parent);
    44	
    45	        try {
    46	            const response = await fetch(API_URL + '?' + params.toString(), {
    47	                headers: { 'Accept': 'application/json' },
    48	                cache: 'no-store'
    49	            });
    50	
    51	            const contentType = response.headers.get('content-type') || '';
    52	            const data = contentType.includes('application/json')
    53	                ? await response.json()
    54	                : null;
    55	
    56	            if (!response.ok) throw new Error('Erreur HTTP ' + response.status);
    57	            if (!Array.isArray(data)) throw new Error('Reponse non JSON');
    58	
    59	            select.innerHTML = '';
    60	            select.appendChild(new Option(placeholder, ''));
    61	            data.forEach(item => select.appendChild(new Option(item.nom, item.nom)));
    62	            select.disabled = false;
    63	            console.log('[Localisation]', type, ':', data.length, 'element(s) charge(s)');
    64	        } catch (error) {
    65	            console.error('[Localisation] Echec chargement', { type, parent, erreur: error });
    66	            select.innerHTML = '';
    67	            select.appendChild(new Option('Erreur de chargement', ''));
    68	            select.disabled = true;
    69	        }
    70	    }
    71	
    72	    function initSelects(root) {
    73	        const scope = root || document;
    74	        const dep = scope.querySelector('#' + SELECT_IDS.departement);
    75	        const com = scope.querySelector('#' + SELECT_IDS.commune);
    76	        const arr = scope.querySelector('#' + SELECT_IDS.arrondissement);
    77	        const quartier = scope.querySelector('#' + SELECT_IDS.quartier);
    78	
    79	        if (!dep) {
    80	            console.warn('[Localisation] #deb-departement introuvable');
    81	            return false;
    82	        }
    83	
    84	        if (dep.dataset.localisationReady === '1') return true;
    85	        dep.dataset.localisationReady = '1';
    86	
    87	        if (com) com.disabled = true;
    88	        if (arr) arr.disabled = true;
    89	        if (quartier) quartier.disabled = true;
    90	
    91	        chargerOptions('departement', '', SELECT_IDS.departement, '-- Departement --');
    92	
    93	        dep.addEventListener('change', function () {
    94	            resetSelect(SELECT_IDS.commune, '-- Commune --', true);
    95	            resetSelect(SELECT_IDS.arrondissement, '-- Arrondissement --', true);
    96	            resetSelect(SELECT_IDS.quartier, '-- Quartier --', true);
    97	            if (this.value) chargerOptions('commune', this.value, SELECT_IDS.commune, '-- Commune --');
    98	        });
    99	
   100	        if (com) com.addEventListener('change', function () {
   101	            resetSelect(SELECT_IDS.arrondissement, '-- Arrondissement --', true);
   102	            resetSelect(SELECT_IDS.quartier, '-- Quartier --', true);
   103	            if (this.value) chargerOptions('arrondissement', this.value, SELECT_IDS.arrondissement, '-- Arrondissement --');
   104	        });
   105	
   106	        if (arr) arr.addEventListener('change', function () {
   107	            resetSelect(SELECT_IDS.quartier, '-- Quartier --', true);
   108	            if (this.value) chargerOptions('quartier', this.value, SELECT_IDS.quartier, '-- Quartier --');
   109	        });
   110	
   111	        return true;
   112	    }
   113	
   114	    function initWhenAvailable() {
   115	        if (initSelects()) return;
   116	        const observer = new MutationObserver(function () {
   117	            if (initSelects()) observer.disconnect();
   118	        });
   119	        observer.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true });
   120	    }
   121	
   122	    window.initLocalisationBenin = initSelects;
   123	window.initSelects = initSelects;
   124	
   125	    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
   126	        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initWhenAvailable);
   127	    } else {
   128	        initWhenAvailable();
   129	    }
   130	})();

    72	function drawCaisseMonth() {
    73	    const year = currentCaisseDate.getFullYear();
    74	    const month = currentCaisseDate.getMonth();
    75	    const firstDay = new Date(year, month, 1);
    76	    const lastDay = new Date(year, month + 1, 0);
    77	    const startOffset = (firstDay.getDay() + 6) % 7;
    78	    const daysInMonth = lastDay.getDate();
    79	    const today = new Date();
    80	
    81	    const container = document.getElementById('caisse-calendrier');
    82	    container.innerHTML = '';
    83	
    84	    for (let i = 0; i < startOffset; i++) {
    85	        container.innerHTML += '<div></div>';
    86	    }
    87	
    88	    for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) {
    89	        const dateStr = `${year}-${String(month+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(d).padStart(2,'0')}`;
    90	        const isToday = d === today.getDate() && month === today.getMonth() && year === today.getFullYear();
    91	        const dayBtn = document.createElement('button');
    92	        dayBtn.className = `p-2 rounded-lg text-sm border ${isToday ? 'border-blue-500' : 'border-slate-200'} hover:bg-slate-50`;
    93	        dayBtn.innerHTML = `<div class="font-medium">${d}</div><div id="solde-${dateStr}" class="text-xs mt-1">...</div><div id="pastille-${dateStr}" class="mt-1"><span class="w-2 h-2 inline-block rounded-full bg-gray-300"></span></div>`;
    94	        dayBtn.onclick = () => selectCaisseDay(dateStr);
    95	        container.appendChild(dayBtn);
    96	    }
    97	
    98	    loadCaissePeriode(year, month);
    99	}
   100	
   101	async function loadCaissePeriode(year, month) {
   102	    const debut = `${year}-${String(month+1).padStart(2,'0')}-01`;
   103	    const fin = new Date(year, month+1, 0).toISOString().split('T')[0];
   104	
   105	    try {
   106	        const res = await apiFetch(`/caisse/periode?debut=${debut}&fin=${fin}`);
   107	        if (!Array.isArray(res)) return;
   108	
   109	        res.forEach(item => {
   110	            const soldeEl = document.getElementById(`solde-${item.jour}`);
   111	            const pastilleEl = document.getElementById(`pastille-${item.jour}`);
   112	
   113	            const encaissements = Number(item.encaissements || 0);
   114	            const decaissements = Number(item.decaissements || 0);
   115	            const epargnes = Number(item.epargnes || 0);
   116	            const penalites = Number(item.penalites || 0);
   117	            const ecart = Number(item.ecart || 0);
   118	            const nbMouvements = Number(item.nb_mouvements || 0);
   119	            const solde = encaissements + epargnes + penalites - decaissements;
   120	
   121	            if (soldeEl) {
   122	                soldeEl.textContent = nbMouvements > 0
   123	                    ? new Intl.NumberFormat('fr-FR', { maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(solde) + ' F'
   124	                    : '';
   125	            }
   126	
   127	            if (!pastilleEl) return;
   128	
   129	            let couleur = 'bg-gray-300';
   130	            let titre = 'Aucun mouvement';
   131	
   132	            if (item.non_cloture) {
   133	                couleur = 'bg-red-500';
   134	                titre = 'Caisse non clôturée';
   135	            } else if (Math.abs(ecart) > 0.009) {
   136	                couleur = 'bg-orange-500';
   137	                titre = 'Écart de caisse : ' + ecart;
   138	            } else if (nbMouvements > 0) {
   139	                couleur = 'bg-green-500';
   140	                titre = nbMouvements + ' mouvement(s)';
   141	            }
   142	
   143	            pastilleEl.innerHTML = `<span title="${titre}" class="w-2 h-2 inline-block rounded-full ${couleur}"></span>`;
   144	        });
   145	    } catch (e) {
   146	        console.error('loadCaissePeriode', e);
   147	    }
   148	}

   181	async function loadCaisseMouvements(date) {
   182	    try {
   183	        const caisseData = await apiFetch('/caisse');
   184	        const mouvements = (caisseData.caisse && caisseData.caisse.mouvements) || [];
   185	        const f = v => new Intl.NumberFormat('fr-FR',{style:'currency',currency:'XOF',maximumFractionDigits:0}).format(v||0);
   186	
   187	        document.getElementById('caisse-mouvements').innerHTML = mouvements.length === 0
   188	            ? '<p class="text-center text-muted py-4">Aucun mouvement</p>'
   189	            : `<table class="min-w-full"><thead><tr><th>Heure</th><th>Type</th><th>Montant</th><th>Mode</th><th>Motif</th></tr></thead><tbody>

     9	            maximumFractionDigits: 0

   175	        html += '</div>';

   178	        html += '<div class="mt-3 p-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold '+(soldeTotal > 0 ? 'bg-red-50 text-red-600' : 'bg-green-50 text-green-600')+'">';
   179	        html += 'Solde restant total : ' + (soldeTotal !== null ? f(soldeTotal) : '--');

   193	        }
   194	        html += '</div>';
   195	        
   196	        html += '<div class="border-t pt-3 mt-3">';
   197	        html += '<h4 class="font-semibold text-sm mb-2">Historique des achats</h4>';
   198	        html += (hist.ventes && hist.ventes.length > 0)
   199	            ? '<div class="space-y-1 max-h-32 overflow-y-auto">' + hist.ventes.map(function(v){
   200	                return '<div class="flex justify-between text-xs p-1.5 bg-slate-50 rounded"><span>'+v.date+' | '+(v.produits_resume||v.produit||'--')+'</span><span class="font-semibold">'+f(v.montant_total)+' | '+v.statut+'</span></div>';
   201	              }).join('') + '</div>'
   202	            : '<p class="text-xs text-muted">Aucun achat</p>';
   203	        html += '</div>';
   204	
   205	
   206	        // Historique des paiements
   207	        html += '<div class="mt-3">';
   208	        html += '<h4 class="font-semibold text-sm mb-2">Historique des paiements</h4>';
   209	        html += (hist.paiements && hist.paiements.length > 0)
   210	            ? '<div class="space-y-1 max-h-32 overflow-y-auto">' + hist.paiements.map(function(p){
   211	                return '<div class="flex justify-between text-xs p-1.5 bg-slate-50 rounded"><span>'+p.date+' | '+p.mode+'</span><span class="font-semibold text-green-600">'+f(p.montant)+' | '+p.statut+'</span></div>';
   212	              }).join('') + '</div>'
   213	            : '<p class="text-xs text-muted">Aucun paiement</p>';
   214	        html += '</div>';
   215	
   216	        html += '<div class="mt-4 flex gap-2">';
   217	        html += '<button onclick="modifierDebiteur(\''+uuid+'\',\''+d.nom+'\',\''+(d.telephone||'')+'\')" class="flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 bg-amber-600 text-white rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold">Modifier</button>';
   218	        html += '<button onclick="supprimerDebiteur(\''+uuid+'\',\''+d.nom+'\')" class="flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 bg-red-600 text-white rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold">Supprimer</button>';
   219	        html += '<button onclick="document.getElementById(\'detail-modal\').remove()" class="flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 bg-accent text-white rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold">Fermer</button>';
   220	        html += '</div>';

    74	function groupByDate(list, dateKey, montantKey) {
    75	    const map = {};
    76	    list.forEach(item => {
    77	        const date = item[dateKey] ? new Date(item[dateKey]).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short' }) : 'Inconnu';
    78	        map[date] = (map[date] || 0) + parseFloat(item[montantKey] || 0);
    79	    });
    80	    return map;
    81	}

   190	async function loadPenalites(c) {
   191	    const data = await apiFetch('/penalites');

   202	    const totalRefuse = refusees.reduce((s, p) => s + parseFloat(p.montant || 0), 0);

     1	(function () {
     2	    'use strict';
     3	
     4	    function deplacerModales() {
     5	        var ids = [
     6	            'stock-entree-modal',
     7	            'encaisser-modal',
     8	            'stock-sortie-modal',
     9	            'inventaire-modal',
    10	            'caisse-decaissement-modal',
    11	            'caisse-cloture-modal'
    12	        ];
    13	
    14	        ids.forEach(function (id) {
    15	            var modale = document.getElementById(id);
    16	
    17	            if (modale && modale.parentElement !== document.body) {
    18	                document.body.appendChild(modale);
    19	                modale.classList.add('hidden');
    20	            }
    21	        });
    22	    }
    23	
    24	    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    25	        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', deplacerModales);
    26	    } else {
    27	        deplacerModales();
    28	    }
    29	})();

     6	    var depSelect = document.getElementById('deb-departement');
     7	    var comSelect = document.getElementById('deb-commune');
     8	    var arrSelect = document.getElementById('deb-arrondissement');
     9	    var vilSelect = document.getElementById('deb-village');
    10	    
    11	    if (!depSelect) {
    12	        console.warn('[LOC] #deb-departement introuvable');
    13	        return;
    14	    }
    15	    
    16	    // Charger les départements
    17	    fetch('/api/localisations?type=departement')
    18	        .then(r => r.json())
    19	        .then(data => {

    21	                data.map(d => '<option value="' + d.nom + '">' + d.nom + '</option>').join('');
    22	            console.log('[LOC] ' + data.length + ' departements charges');
    23	        });
    24	    
    25	    // Quand on change de département
    26	    depSelect.onchange = function() {
    27	        comSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Commune --</option>';
    28	        arrSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Arrondissement --</option>';
    29	        vilSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Village/Quartier --</option>';
    30	        
    31	        if (!this.value) return;
    32	        
    33	        fetch('/api/localisations?type=commune&parent=' + encodeURIComponent(this.value))
    34	            .then(r => r.json())
    35	            .then(data => {
    36	                comSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Commune --</option>' +
    37	                    data.map(c => '<option value="' + c.nom + '">' + c.nom + '</option>').join('');
    38	                console.log('[LOC] ' + data.length + ' communes charges');
    39	            });
    40	    };
    41	    
    42	    // Quand on change de commune
    43	    if (comSelect) comSelect.onchange = function() {
    44	        arrSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Arrondissement --</option>';
    45	        vilSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Village/Quartier --</option>';
    46	        
    47	        if (!this.value) return;
    48	        
    49	        fetch('/api/localisations?type=arrondissement&parent=' + encodeURIComponent(this.value))
    50	            .then(r => r.json())
    51	            .then(data => {
    52	                arrSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Arrondissement --</option>' +
    53	                    data.map(a => '<option value="' + a.nom + '">' + a.nom + '</option>').join('');
    54	                console.log('[LOC] ' + data.length + ' arrondissements charges');
    55	            });
    56	    };
    57	    
    58	    // Quand on change d'arrondissement
    59	    if (arrSelect) arrSelect.onchange = function() {
    60	        vilSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Village/Quartier --</option>';
    61	        
    62	        if (!this.value) return;
    63	        
    64	        fetch('/api/localisations?type=quartier&parent=' + encodeURIComponent(this.value))
    65	            .then(r => r.json())
    66	            .then(data => {
    67	                vilSelect.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Village/Quartier --</option>' +
    68	                    data.map(q => '<option value="' + q.nom + '">' + q.nom + '</option>').join('');
    69	                console.log('[LOC] ' + data.length + ' quartiers charges');
    70	            });
    71	    };
    72	}

    74	function getLocalisationComplete() {
    75	    var parts = [];
    76	    var ids = ['deb-departement', 'deb-commune', 'deb-arrondissement', 'deb-village'];
    77	    ids.forEach(function(id) {
    78	        var el = document.getElementById(id);
    79	        if (el && el.value) parts.push(el.value);
    80	    });
    81	    return parts.join(' > ') || '';
    82	}

    57	function openPermissionsModal(uuid, nom, permissions) {
    58	    var perms = permissions || {};
    59	    var html = '<div class="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/50" id="perm-modal-overlay" onclick="if(event.target===this)closePermissionsModal()">';
    60	    html += '<div class="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 w-full max-w-md shadow-2xl fade-in max-h-96 overflow-y-auto">';
    61	    html += '<h3 class="text-lg font-bold mb-4">Permissions de ' + nom + '</h3>';
    62	    html += '<div class="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">';
    63	    allPages.forEach(function(p) {
    64	        var checked = perms[p.id] !== undefined ? perms[p.id] : true;
    65	        html += '<label class="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 bg-slate-50 rounded-lg cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-100 text-sm"><input type="checkbox" '+(checked?'checked':'')+' onchange="togglePermission(\''+uuid+'\',\''+p.id+'\',this.checked)" class="w-4 h-4 text-accent">'+p.label+'</label>';
    66	    });
    67	    html += '</div>';
    68	    html += '<div class="flex gap-3 pt-4"><button onclick="closePermissionsModal()" class="flex-1 px-4 py-2.5 bg-accent text-white rounded-xl text-sm font-semibold">Fermer</button></div>';
    69	    html += '</div></div>';
    70	    
    71	    var existing = document.getElementById('perm-modal-overlay');
    72	    if(existing) existing.remove();
    73	    document.body.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
    74	}

    18	                        p.map(function(x){
    19	                            var benefice = (x.prix_vente||0) - (x.prix_achat||0);
    20	                            var marge = (x.prix_achat > 0) ? ((benefice / x.prix_achat) * 100).toFixed(1) + '%' : '--';
    21	                            return '<tr>'+
    22	                                '<td class="font-medium">'+x.nom+'</td>'+
    23	                                '<td><input type="number" value="'+(x.prix_achat||0)+'" onchange="updateProduitPrix(\''+x.uuid+'\',\'prix_achat\',this.value)" class="w-24 px-2 py-1 border rounded text-xs text-right"></td>'+
    24	                                '<td><input type="number" value="'+(x.prix_vente||0)+'" onchange="updateProduitPrix(\''+x.uuid+'\',\'prix_vente\',this.value)" class="w-24 px-2 py-1 border rounded text-xs text-right"></td>'+
    25	                                '<td class="font-semibold text-green-600">'+f(benefice)+'</td>'+
    26	                                '<td class="text-xs">'+marge+'</td>'+
    27	                                '<td><span class="badge '+(x.stock<=x.seuil_alerte?'badge-danger':'badge-success')+'">'+(x.stock||0)+'</span></td>'+
    28	                                '<td><div class="flex gap-1">'+
    29	                                    '<button onclick="categoriserProduit(\''+x.uuid+'\',\''+x.nom+'\')" class="text-blue-600 text-xs">Cat.</button>'+
    30	                                    '<button onclick="supprimerProduit(\''+x.uuid+'\',\''+x.nom+'\')" class="text-red-600 text-xs">Suppr.</button>'+
    31	                                '</div></td>'+
    32	                            '</tr>';
    33	                        }).join('')+
    34	                    '</tbody></table>'+
    35	                '</div>'+
    36	            '</div>'+
    37	            '<div class="panel max-w-md">'+
    38	                '<h3>Resume des benefices</h3>'+
    39	                '<div class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-3 mt-4">'+
    40	                    '<div class="text-center"><span class="text-xs text-muted">Valeur achat</span><div class="font-bold">'+f(p.reduce((s,x)=>s+(x.prix_achat||0)*(x.stock||0),0))+'</div></div>'+
    41	                    '<div class="text-center"><span class="text-xs text-muted">Valeur vente</span><div class="font-bold text-green-600">'+f(p.reduce((s,x)=>s+(x.prix_vente||0)*(x.stock||0),0))+'</div></div>'+
    42	                    '<div class="text-center"><span class="text-xs text-muted">Benefice potentiel</span><div class="font-bold text-accent">'+f(p.reduce((s,x)=>s+((x.prix_vente||0)-(x.prix_achat||0))*(x.stock||0),0))+'</div></div>'+
    43	                '</div>'+
    44	            '</div>'+
    45	        '</div>';
    46	    });
    47	}

    30	function switchRapport(type) {
    31	    rapportType = type;
    32	    document.querySelectorAll('#rapport-filtres .chip').forEach(ch => ch.classList.remove('chip--active'));
    33	    const btn = document.querySelector(`[data-type="${type}"]`);
    34	    if (btn) btn.classList.add('chip--active');
    35	    chargerRapport();
    36	}

    38	function chargerRapport() {
    39	    const debut = document.getElementById('rapport-debut').value;
    40	    const fin = document.getElementById('rapport-fin').value;
    41	    let params = '';
    42	    if (debut) params += '&date_debut=' + debut;
    43	    if (fin) params += '&date_fin=' + fin;
    44	
    45	    let endpoint = '/rapports/' + rapportType;
    46	    if (rapportType === 'ventes') endpoint += '?' + params.slice(1);
    47	    else if (rapportType === 'recouvrements') endpoint += '?' + params.slice(1);
    48	    else endpoint = '/rapports/resume';
    49	
    50	    apiFetch(endpoint).then(r => {
    51	        if (rapportType === 'resume') {
    52	            afficherResume(r);
    53	        } else {
    54	            afficherTableauRapport(r);
    55	        }
    56	    }).catch(e => showAlert('Erreur : ' + e.message));
    57	}
    58	
    59	function afficherTableauRapport(data) {
    60	    const conteneur = document.getElementById('rapport-contenu');
    61	    if (!Array.isArray(data) || data.length === 0) {
    62	        conteneur.innerHTML = '<p class="text-muted text-center py-4">Aucune donnée</p>';
    63	        return;
    64	    }
    65	    const f = v => new Intl.NumberFormat('fr-FR',{style:'currency',currency:'XOF',maximumFractionDigits:0}).format(v||0);
    66	
    67	    let html = '<div class="table-wrapper"><table><thead><tr>';
    68	    if (rapportType === 'ventes') {
    69	        html += '<th>Date</th><th>Débiteur</th><th>Agent</th><th>Type</th><th>Montant</th><th>Payé</th><th>Restant</th><th>Statut</th>';
    70	    } else if (rapportType === 'recouvrements') {
    71	        html += '<th>Date</th><th>Débiteur</th><th>Agent</th><th>Montant</th><th>Mode</th><th>Statut</th>';
    72	    }
    73	    html += '</tr></thead><tbody>';
    74	
    75	    data.forEach(v => {
    76	        if (rapportType === 'ventes') {
    77	            html += `<tr><td>${new Date(v.date_debut).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR')}</td><td>${v.debiteur?.nom || '--'} ${v.debiteur?.prenom || ''}</td><td>${v.agent?.nom || '--'}</td><td>${v.type_vente}</td><td>${f(v.montant_total)}</td><td>${f(v.total_paye)}</td><td>${f(v.reste_a_payer)}</td><td>${v.statut}</td></tr>`;
    78	        } else if (rapportType === 'recouvrements') {
    79	            html += `<tr><td>${new Date(v.date_recouvrement).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR')}</td><td>${v.vente?.debiteur?.nom || '--'} ${v.vente?.debiteur?.prenom || ''}</td><td>${v.agent?.nom || '--'}</td><td>${f(v.montant)}</td><td>${v.mode_paiement}</td><td>${v.statut}</td></tr>`;
    80	        }
    81	    });
    82	
    83	    html += '</tbody></table></div>';
    84	    conteneur.innerHTML = html;
    85	}

   105	function exporterCSV() {
   106	    const token = localStorage.getItem('sourougnon_token') || '';
   107	    const debut = document.getElementById('rapport-debut').value;
   108	    const fin = document.getElementById('rapport-fin').value;
   109	    let url = `/api/rapports/${rapportType}?format=csv`;
   110	    if (debut) url += '&date_debut=' + debut;
   111	    if (fin) url += '&date_fin=' + fin;
   112	    url += '&token=' + encodeURIComponent(token);
   113	    window.open(url, '_blank');
   114	}
   115	
   116	function exporterPDF() {
   117	    const token = localStorage.getItem('sourougnon_token') || '';
   118	    const debut = document.getElementById('rapport-debut').value;
   119	    const fin = document.getElementById('rapport-fin').value;
   120	    let url = (rapportType === 'resume') ? '/api/rapports/resume-pdf' : `/api/rapports/${rapportType}?format=pdf`;
   121	    if (debut) url += (url.includes('?')?'&':'?') + 'date_debut=' + debut;
   122	    if (fin) url += (url.includes('?')?'&':'?') + 'date_fin=' + fin;
   123	    url += (url.includes('?')?'&':'?') + 'token=' + encodeURIComponent(token);
   124	    window.open(url, '_blank');
   125	}

     1	// === MOTEUR DE RECHERCHE GLOBALE ===
     2	var rechercheTimeout;
     3	
     4	function rechercheGlobale(query) {
     5	    clearTimeout(rechercheTimeout);
     6	    var resultsDiv = document.getElementById('search-results');
     7	    if (!resultsDiv) return;
     8	    
     9	    if (!query || query.length < 2) {
    10	        resultsDiv.classList.add('hidden');
    11	        return;
    12	    }
    13	    
    14	    rechercheTimeout = setTimeout(function() {
    15	        apiFetch('/recherche?q=' + encodeURIComponent(query)).then(function(data) {
    16	            if (!data || (!data.debiteurs.length && !data.ventes.length && !data.agents.length && !data.produits.length)) {
    17	                resultsDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="p-4 text-sm text-muted text-center">Aucun resultat pour "' + query + '"</div>';
    18	                resultsDiv.classList.remove('hidden');
    19	                return;
    20	            }
    21	            
    22	            var html = '';
    23	            
    24	            if (data.debiteurs && data.debiteurs.length > 0) {
    25	                html += '<div class="p-2 text-xs font-semibold text-muted uppercase">Debiteurs (' + data.debiteurs.length + ')</div>';
    26	                data.debiteurs.forEach(function(d) {
    27	                    html += '<div class="px-4 py-2 hover:bg-slate-50 cursor-pointer text-sm" onclick="loadPage(\'debiteurs\');document.getElementById(\'search-results\').classList.add(\'hidden\')">' +
    28	                        '<span class="font-medium">' + d.nom + ' ' + (d.prenom||'') + '</span> ' +
    29	                        '<span class="text-muted text-xs">' + (d.quartier||'') + ' | ' + (d.telephone||'') + '</span></div>';
    30	                });
    31	            }
    32	            
    33	            if (data.agents && data.agents.length > 0) {
    34	                html += '<div class="p-2 text-xs font-semibold text-muted uppercase border-t">Agents (' + data.agents.length + ')</div>';
    35	                data.agents.forEach(function(a) {
    36	                    html += '<div class="px-4 py-2 hover:bg-slate-50 cursor-pointer text-sm" onclick="loadPage(\'agents\');document.getElementById(\'search-results\').classList.add(\'hidden\')">' +
    37	                        '<span class="font-medium">' + a.nom + ' ' + (a.prenom||'') + '</span> ' +
    38	                        '<span class="text-muted text-xs">' + a.email + ' | ' + a.role + '</span></div>';
    39	                });
    40	            }
    41	            
    42	            if (data.ventes && data.ventes.length > 0) {
    43	                html += '<div class="p-2 text-xs font-semibold text-muted uppercase border-t">Ventes (' + data.ventes.length + ')</div>';
    44	                data.ventes.forEach(function(v) {
    45	                    html += '<div class="px-4 py-2 hover:bg-slate-50 cursor-pointer text-sm" onclick="loadPage(\'ventes\');document.getElementById(\'search-results\').classList.add(\'hidden\')">' +
    46	                        '<span class="font-medium">' + (v.debiteur_nom||'Client') + '</span> ' +
    47	                        '<span class="text-muted text-xs">' + v.type_vente + ' | ' + new Intl.NumberFormat('fr-FR',{style:'currency',currency:'XOF'}).format(v.montant_total||0) + '</span></div>';
    48	                });
    49	            }
    50	            
    51	            if (data.produits && data.produits.length > 0) {
    52	                html += '<div class="p-2 text-xs font-semibold text-muted uppercase border-t">Produits (' + data.produits.length + ')</div>';
    53	                data.produits.forEach(function(p) {
    54	                    html += '<div class="px-4 py-2 hover:bg-slate-50 cursor-pointer text-sm" onclick="loadPage(\'produits\');document.getElementById(\'search-results\').classList.add(\'hidden\')">' +
    55	                        '<span class="font-medium">' + p.nom + '</span> ' +
    56	                        '<span class="text-muted text-xs">Stock: ' + (p.stock||0) + ' | Prix: ' + new Intl.NumberFormat('fr-FR',{style:'currency',currency:'XOF'}).format(p.prix_vente||0) + '</span></div>';
    57	                });
    58	            }
    59	            
    60	            resultsDiv.innerHTML = html;
    61	            resultsDiv.classList.remove('hidden');
    62	        }).catch(function(e) {
    63	            console.error('Erreur recherche:', e);
    64	        });
    65	    }, 300);
    66	}

    38	function renderMouvementsStock(m) {
    39	    function f(v) {
    40	        return new Intl.NumberFormat('fr-FR', { style: 'currency', currency: 'XOF', maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(v);
    41	    }
    42	    var c = document.getElementById('mouvements-stock-content');
    43	    if (!c) return;
    44	    var tb = { entree: 'badge-success', vente: 'badge-danger', sortie: 'badge-danger', perte: 'badge-danger', retour: 'badge-warning', inventaire: 'badge-info' };
    45	    var actionBadge = { creation: 'badge-success', modification: 'badge-warning', suppression: 'badge-danger', inventaire: 'badge-info' };
    46	    
    47	    c.innerHTML = '<div class="table-wrapper"><table><thead><tr><th>Date</th><th>Type</th><th>Action</th><th>Produit</th><th>Qte</th><th>Prix Unit.</th><th>Fournisseur</th><th>Actions</th></tr></thead><tbody>' +
    48	    (m.length > 0 ? m.map(function(x) {
    49	        return '<tr>' +
    50	        '<td class="text-xs">' + new Date(x.created_at).toLocaleDateString('fr-FR') + ' ' + new Date(x.created_at).toLocaleTimeString('fr-FR', {hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}) + '</td>' +
    51	        '<td><span class="badge ' + (tb[x.type] || 'badge-info') + '">' + x.type + '</span></td>' +
    52	        '<td><span class="badge ' + (actionBadge[x.action] || 'badge-success') + '">' + (x.action || 'creation') + '</span></td>' +
    53	        '<td class="font-medium">' + (x.produit ? x.produit.nom : '-') + '</td>' +
    54	        '<td>' + x.quantite + '</td>' +
    55	        '<td>' + f(x.prix_unitaire) + '</td>' +
    56	        '<td>' + (x.fournisseur || '-') + '</td>' +
    57	        '<td><div class="flex gap-1">' +
    58	        '<button onclick="openModifierMouvementModal(' + x.id + ',' + x.quantite + ',' + x.prix_unitaire + ',\'' + (x.fournisseur || '').replace(/'/g, "\\'") + '\')" class="text-amber-600 text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-1 bg-amber-50 rounded hover:bg-amber-100">Mod.</button>' +
    59	        '<button onclick="openSupprimerMouvementModal(' + x.id + ')" class="text-red-600 text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-1 bg-red-50 rounded hover:bg-red-100">Suppr.</button>' +
    60	        '</div></td></tr>';
    61	    }).join('') : '<tr><td colspan="8" class="text-center text-muted py-4">Aucun mouvement trouve</td></tr>') +
    62	    '</tbody></table></div>';
    63	}

     1	// === PAGE TOURNÉES ===
     2	function loadTournees(c) {
     3	    apiFetch('/tournees').then(function(list) {
     4	        if (!Array.isArray(list)) list = [];
     5	        const rows = list.map(function(t) {
     6	            const agent = t.agent ? (t.agent.nom + ' ' + t.agent.prenom) : '-';
     7	            const debut = t.heure_demarrage ? new Date(t.heure_demarrage).toLocaleTimeString('fr-FR') : '-';
     8	            const fin = t.heure_fin ? new Date(t.heure_fin).toLocaleTimeString('fr-FR') : '-';
     9	            let duree = '-';
    10	            if (t.heure_demarrage && t.heure_fin) {
    11	                const ms = new Date(t.heure_fin) - new Date(t.heure_demarrage);
    12	                const mins = Math.round(ms / 60000);
    13	                duree = Math.floor(mins / 60) + 'h ' + (mins % 60) + 'm';
    14	            }
    15	            const statut = t.statut === 'en_cours' ? '<span class="badge badge-info">En cours</span>' : '<span class="badge badge-success">Terminée</span>';
    16	            return `<tr>
    17	                <td>${agent}</td>
    18	                <td>${t.date_tournee}</td>
    19	                <td>${debut}</td>
    20	                <td>${fin}</td>
    21	                <td>${duree}</td>
    22	                <td>${statut}</td>
    23	            </tr>`;
    24	        }).join('');
    25	        c.innerHTML = `<div class="fade-in space-y-6">
    26	            <h3 class="text-xl font-bold">Tournées des agents</h3>
    27	            <div class="panel">
    28	                <div class="table-wrapper">
    29	                    <table>
    30	                        <thead><tr><th>Agent</th><th>Date</th><th>Démarrage</th><th>Fin</th><th>Durée</th><th>Statut</th></tr></thead>
    31	                        <tbody>${rows || '<tr><td colspan="6" class="text-center">Aucune tournée</td></tr>'}</tbody>
    32	                    </table>
    33	                </div>
    34	            </div>
    35	        </div>`;
    36	    }).catch(function() {
    37	        c.innerHTML = '<div class="panel text-center py-12"><p class="text-muted">Erreur chargement.</p></div>';
    38	    });
    39	}

    47	function onDebiteurChangeCredit() {
    48	    var debiteurId = document.getElementById('vcr-debiteur').value;
    49	    var scoreBadge = document.getElementById('vcr-score-badge');
    50	    var motifField = document.getElementById('vcr-motif');
    51	    
    52	    if (!debiteurId) {
    53	        if (scoreBadge) scoreBadge.innerHTML = '';
    54	        if (motifField) motifField.required = false;
    55	        return;
    56	    }
    57	    
    58	    apiFetch('/debiteurs/' + debiteurId + '/score').then(function(r) {
    59	        if (scoreBadge && r.score !== undefined) {
    60	            var color = r.score >= 80 ? '#00c853' : r.score >= 60 ? '#0066ff' : r.score >= 40 ? '#f59e0b' : '#ef4444';
    61	            scoreBadge.innerHTML = '<span class="badge" style="background:'+color+'20;color:'+color+';font-weight:bold;font-size:12px;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:6px;display:inline-block;">Score: ' + r.score + '% (' + (r.label || '') + ')</span>';
    62	            
    63	            // Si le score est < 40, le motif devient obligatoire
    64	            if (motifField) {
    65	                if (r.score < 40) {
    66	                    motifField.required = true;
    67	                    motifField.placeholder = 'MOTIF OBLIGATOIRE - Score insuffisant (' + r.score + '%)';
    68	                    motifField.classList.add('border-red-500');
    69	                } else {
    70	                    motifField.required = false;
    71	                    motifField.placeholder = 'Ex: Client fidèle, situation exceptionnelle...';
    72	                    motifField.classList.remove('border-red-500');
    73	                }
    74	            }
    75	        }
    76	    }).catch(function() {
    77	        if (scoreBadge) scoreBadge.innerHTML = '';
    78	    });
    79	}
